title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted
english: The US military successfully destroyed or disabled three Iranian-linked oil tankers in response to ballistic missile attacks aimed at two of its warships. American officials stated that their vessels evaded the incoming fire without sustaining any casualties. This military action serves as a warning, with the US command declaring its readiness to target Iran's oil fleet if American forces continue to be threatened.

title: What different world maps get right - and what they get wrong
english: The United Nations is pushing to replace the traditional Mercator map, which inaccurately displays the size of continents, with the more precise Equal Earth projection. While the Mercator map was originally designed to help 16th-century sailors navigate by keeping straight lines, it significantly distorts landmasses by shrinking regions near the equator and enlarging those near the poles. Critics argue that this representation has historically downplayed the importance of Africa by making it appear much smaller than its true size.

title: Coach Luis Enrique unconcerned by PSG’s poor start to French league season
english: Paris Saint-Germain is experiencing its worst league start in nearly two decades, having failed to win any of their first three matches. Despite the poor results, coach Luis Enrique remains optimistic, arguing that his team performed well and was simply unlucky against Monaco. The club has demonstrated their ongoing faith in him by extending his contract through 2030 as they prepare for the Champions League.

title: Why has the Trump administration ordered staff to take polygraph tests?
english: The Trump administration has mandated polygraph tests for dozens of Pentagon and military staff as part of an investigation into the unauthorized release of classified information. This crackdown follows media reports suggesting that U.S. weapons stockpiles in the Middle East are critically low, a claim the government officially disputes. Officials hope these tests will identify the source of the leaks and discourage other employees from sharing sensitive national security details with journalists.

title: UK gov’t condemns masked anti-immigrant protesters blocking Dover port
english: Masked protesters recently blocked the roads leading to the Port of Dover, causing significant travel delays and forcing ferry traffic to stop temporarily. The UK government strongly condemned the demonstration, stating that the intimidating behavior of the participants went well beyond the bounds of peaceful protest. Authorities have since restored normal operations at the port after engaging with the crowd to clear the routes.

title: Arsenal vs Chelsea: Premier League – prediction, teams, lineups
english: Arsenal and Chelsea are set to face off this Sunday at Emirates Stadium in an highly anticipated Premier League match. This event marks the first time managers Mikel Arteta and Xabi Alonso will compete against each other in the English top flight, highlighting their long-standing friendship and professional history.

title: ‘Stop the boats’ masked protesters block England’s Port of Dover
english: Masked protesters wearing black gathered at England's Port of Dover on Saturday to demonstrate against immigration. The group blocked major roads leading to the busy ferry terminal, causing significant travel delays. They chanted slogans calling for an end to small boat crossings across the English Channel.

title: US military says it has destroyed three Iranian oil tankers
english: The US military neutralized three oil tankers connected to Iran's Revolutionary Guard following failed attacks by Iranian forces on American ships. Centcom confirmed the vessels were targeted because they were part of a financial network supporting the IRGC and its regional allies. The operation, which involved strikes that rendered the ships permanently inoperable, was captured in military footage showing the vessels engulfed in flames.

title: Proposed Hormuz passage deal not feasible for shipping industry: Report
english: A proposal for Iran to gain oversight of ships moving through the Strait of Hormuz is considered impractical by shipping industry experts due to existing international sanctions and financial constraints. Leading maritime associations warn that implementing transit fees would violate established global navigation laws and disrupt the current traffic routing system. This plan, which would involve both Iranian and Omani involvement, faces significant legal and logistical hurdles.
amharic: ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ የሚያልፉ መርከቦችን የመቆጣጠር ስልጣን እንዲኖራት የቀረበው ሀሳብ፣ ባለው ዓለም አቀፍ ማዕቀብ እና የፋይናንስ ውስንነቶች ምክንያት ተግባራዊ ሊሆን እንደማይችል የዘርፉ ባለሙያዎች ገለጹ። ዋና ዋና የባህር ትራንስፖርት ማህበራት እንደገለጹት፣ ይህ እቅድ በዓለም አቀፍ የመርከብ ጉዞ ህጎች ላይ ተጽእኖ የሚፈጥር እና ተጨማሪ ክፍያዎችን በመጫን ነባሩን የትራፊክ ስርዓት የሚያናጋ ነው። ይህ በኢራን እና በኦማን መካከል የታቀደው ስምምነት በርካታ ህጋዊ እና ተግባራዊ ማነቆዎች ያሉበት ጉዳይ ነው።
oromo: Iran galaana Hormuz keessa kan darban dooniiwwan to'achuuf dhiyeessite yaanni ishee, sababa san'iiwwan idil-addunyaa fi rakkoolee maallaqaan kan walqabatu waan ta'eef, hojiirra ooluun isaa ulfaataa ta'uu hayyoonni damee kanaa ibsaniiru. Waldaaleen dooniiwwan gurguddoon akka jedhanitti, yaanni gatii kaffaltii darbiinsaa gaafachuu kun seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsu fi sirna geejjiba galaana yeroo ammaa jiru kan jeequ dha. Karoorri Iran fi Oman gidduutti dhiyaate kun rakkoolee seeraa fi hojiirra oolmaa cimaa qaba.

title: ‘Governments continue to fail’: Freedom Flotilla sails again, vowing to challenge Israel’s Gaza blockade
english: The Freedom Flotilla Coalition is launching a new international mission to challenge Israel’s blockade on Gaza by sailing ships from Europe to the territory this October. Organizers state that the action is necessary because world governments have failed to address the urgent humanitarian crisis involving the lack of food, fuel, and medical supplies. Despite the history of violent confrontations and past abuses faced by activists, the group remains committed to advocating for Palestinian dignity and freedom.
amharic: የፍሪደም ፍሎቲላ ጥምረት የእስራኤልን የጋዛ ከበባ ለመቃወም ከፈረንሳይ ወደቦች በመነሳት በጥቅምት ወር ወደ ጋዛ ለመጓዝ አዲስ ዓለም አቀፍ ጥረት ጀምሯል። ቡድኑ የአለም መንግስታት በጋዛ ያለውን የምግብ፣ የነዳጅ እና የህክምና እጥረት ችግር ለመፍታት ባለመቻላቸው ይህንን እርምጃ መውሰድ እንዳስፈለገ ገልጿል። ቀደም ሲል በነበሩ ተልዕኮዎች በበጎ ፈቃደኞች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥቃት እና እንግልት ደርሶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ጥምረቱ ለፍልስጤማውያን መብት እና ነፃነት መቆሙን እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል።
oromo: Waldaan 'Freedom Flotilla' jedhamu kanneen biyyoota Awurooppaa irraa ka'uun, adoolessa dhufu gara Gazaatti qajeeluun itti-ba'iinsa (blockade) Israa'el cabsuuf karoorfateera. Qaamni kun akka jedhutti, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame mootummoonni addunyaa rakkoo gargaarsa namoomaa fi dhabama nyaata, qorichaa fi boba'aa Gaza keessa jiru furuu waan dadhabaniifidha. Dararaa fi reebicha kanaan dura isaan irra ga'aa ture hunda dandamatanii, waldaan kun mirgaa fi kabaja ummata Palastayinii kabachiisuuf qabsoo isaanii itti fufuuf murteeffataniiru.

title: ‘Governments continue to fail’: Freedom Flotilla sails again, vowing to challenge Israel’s Gaza blockade
english: The Freedom Flotilla Coalition has launched a new international mission to challenge Israel’s ongoing blockade of Gaza. Despite facing significant risks and past violence, participants plan to sail ships through various European ports before attempting to reach Gaza in October to deliver humanitarian aid and advocate for Palestinian rights. The coalition is urging global governments to impose sanctions on Israel and ensure safe passage for their vessels while highlighting the urgent need for food, medicine, and fuel in the region.
amharic: የፍሪደም ፍሎቲላ ጥምረት የእስራኤልን የጋዛ እገዳ ለመቃወም አዲስ ዓለም አቀፍ ተልዕኮ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ተሳታፊዎቹ ባለፉት ጊዜያት የደረሰባቸውን ጥቃት እና አደጋዎች ቢገጥሙም፣ በኦክቶበር ወር የሰብአዊ እርዳታ ይዘው ወደ ጋዛ ለመድረስ እቅድ አላቸው። ጥምረቱ ዓለም አቀፍ መንግስታት በእስራኤል ላይ ማዕቀብ እንዲጥሉ እና ለመርከቦቻቸው ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ ጉዞ እንዲያመቻቹ እንዲሁም በጋዛ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የምግብ፣ የመድኃኒት እና የነዳጅ እጥረት እንዲፈቱ እየጠየቀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Waltajjii Freedom Flotilla jedhamu Israa'el gaa'ila Gaza irra keesse cabsuuf sochii haaraa jalqabuu isaa beeksiseera. Hirmaattotni kanaan dura rakkoo fi miidhaa guddaa isaan mudate iyyuu osoo hin jiru, ji'a Onkololeessaa keessa gargaarsa namoomaa qabatanii Gaza dhaquuf karoorfataniiru. Waltajjichi mootummoonni addunyaa Israa'el irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhatan fi dooniiwwan isaanii nageenyaan akka darban gaafachaa, Gaza keessatti rakkoo nyaata, qorichaa fi boba'aa mudate irratti xiyyeeffannoo akka kennan dhaameera.

title: Israel bombs and shells areas across Gaza
english: The Israeli military conducted widespread strikes throughout the Gaza Strip using aircraft, artillery, and ground vehicles. Attacks were reported across northern, central, and southern regions, including gunfire and shelling near refugee camps and urban areas. Despite the intensity of these operations, there have been no immediate reports of casualties.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በጋዛ ሰርጥ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች በአየር፣ በታንክ እና በመድፍ ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። ጥቃቶቹ በጋዛ ሰሜናዊ፣ መካከለኛ እና ደቡባዊ ክፍሎች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ሲሆን የመኖሪያ ቤቶች እና የስደተኞች ካምፖች አካባቢዎች ተካተዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ በደረሰው ጥቃት ስለሞቱ ወይም ስለቆሰሉ ሰዎች የተዘገበ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el iddoowwan garaa garaa Gaazaa keessatti xiyyaaraan, madafii fi konkolaataa waraanaan haleellaa geggeesseera. Haleellaan kun gammoojjii Gaazaa kaaba, giddugaleessa fi kibbaatti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, manneen jireenyaa fi bakkeewwan baqattootaa dabalata. Hamma yoonaatti miidhaan lubbuu qaqqabuu isaa gabaasni ifa ta'e hin jiru.

title: US envoys arrive in Moscow ahead of Ukraine talks
english: Two senior US envoys, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, have arrived in Moscow to present a new peace proposal aimed at resolving the conflict in Ukraine. After their meetings in Russia, the pair is scheduled to travel to Kyiv for discussions with President Volodymyr Zelensky. Despite these diplomatic efforts, tensions remain high as Russia continues to conduct military strikes near Ukrainian airports.
amharic: ሁለት ከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ መልዕክተኞች፣ ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ እና ጃሬድ ኩሽነር፣ በዩክሬን ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም የታለመ አዲስ የሰላም ሃሳብ ይዘው ሞስኮ ገብተዋል። በሩሲያ ከሚያደርጉት ውይይት በኋላ ወደ ኪቭ በማቅናት ከፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ጋር ለመነጋገር ቀጠሮ ይዘዋል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ የዲፕሎማሲ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ሩሲያ በዩክሬን አየር ማረፊያዎች አካባቢ ጥቃት መፈጸሟን በመቀጠሏ ውጥረቱ አሁንም እንደቀጠለ ነው።
oromo: Ergamtoonni olaanoo Ameerikaa lama, Steve Witkoff fi Jared Kushner, waraana Yukreenii dhaabsisuuf yaadamee kan qophaaye yaada nagaa haaraa tokko qabatanii gara Moskoo dhaqqabaniiru. Roosiyaatti marii erga godhanii booda, gara Kiyiv deemuun Pireezidaant Volodimir Zeelenskii waliin mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru. Yaaliin diippiloomaasii kun jiraatus, Roosiyaan buufataalee xiyyaaraa Yukreeniitti haleellaa raawwachuu waan itti fufteef, waldhabdee fi tasgabbii dhabuun ammas itti fufee jira.

title: Nepal rescuers try to reach dozens trapped in tunnel after two found alive
english: Rescue teams in Nepal are intensifying efforts to reach dozens of workers trapped in hydropower tunnels following massive flash floods triggered by a glacial collapse. Hopes were boosted when two survivors were discovered alive in a tunnel nine days after the disaster. While these rescue operations continue, thousands remain missing across the region, and authorities are working to locate others believed to be trapped in various sites.
amharic: በኔፓል በተከሰተ የበረዶ ግግር መውደቅ ምክንያት በተፈጠረ ድንገተኛ ጎርፍ በውሃ ኃይል ማመንጫ ዋሻዎች ውስጥ ተጠልፈው የነበሩ ሰዎችን ለማዳን ጥረቶች እየተጠናከሩ ነው። ከአደጋው ዘጠኝ ቀናት በኋላ ሁለት ሰዎች በሕይወት መገኘታቸው ለተስፋ መቁረጥ ለተቃረቡ ቤተሰቦች ትልቅ ተስፋን ፈንጥቋል። አሁንም በክልሉ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የገቡበት ባለመታወቁ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች በሌሎች አካባቢዎችም ተጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Nepaalli keessatti balaa caba cabii irraa ka'een lolaa tasaa erga mudatee booda, hojjettoonni daandii bishaanii keessatti hafan lubbuun oolchuuf tattaaffiin cimaan taasifamaa jira. Balaa sana booda guyyaa sagalitti namoonni lama lubbuun argamuun isaanii abdii guddaa uumee jira. Namoonni kumaan lakkaawwaman amma iyyuu bakka bu'aan isaanii waan hin beekamneef, ogeeyyonni gargaarsaa iddoo gara garaatti sakatta'iinsa isaanii itti fufanii jiru.

title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
english: President Trump has issued an executive order directing the Interior Secretary to evaluate whether to remove federal endangered species protections for grey and Mexican wolves. The order aims to support ranchers by potentially allowing them to protect livestock from wolf attacks, citing the importance of the agricultural industry. Conservationists strongly oppose the move, arguing that the populations have not fully recovered and that existing compensation programs already address farmers' concerns.

oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp, bineensota bosonaa gosa 'grey wolf' fi 'Mexican wolf' jedhaman seera eegumsa bineensota balaa keessa jiran irraa kaasuuf ajaja mallatteessaniiru. Ajajni kun horsiisee bulaan loon isaanii akka hin midhamneef murtoo kana akka gochuuf kan akeekkatedha. Haata'u malee, gareewwan eegumsa naannoo, lakkoofsi bineensota kanaa ammallee guutummaatti hin deebine waan ta'eef, murtoon kun hojii waggoota hedduu mancaasuu danda'a jechuun mormaniiru.

title: LIVE: India vs Pakistan – Women’s T20 Asia Cup
english: The Indian and Pakistani women's cricket teams are competing in a Group A match during the 2026 Women’s T20 Asia Cup. This high-profile game is being hosted at the Dubai International Stadium in the United Arab Emirates. The match is scheduled to begin at 6:30 PM local time.
amharic: የህንድ እና የፓኪስታን የሴቶች የክሪኬት ቡድኖች በ2026 የሴቶች የT20 እስያ ዋንጫ የምድብ ኤ ጨዋታቸውን እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ታላቅ የክሪኬት ግጥሚያ የሚካሄደው በተባበሩት አረብ ኤሚሬቶች፣ ዱባይ ዓለም አቀፍ ስታዲየም ነው። ጨዋታው በዱባይ ሰዓት አቆጣጠር ከምሽቱ 6:30 ላይ ይጀመራል።
oromo: Gareen kirikeetii dubartoota Hindii fi Paakistaan Waancaa Eeshiyaa T20 bara 2026 keessatti tapha garee A irratti wal-morkachaa jiru. Taphi kun kan gaggeeffamaa jiru dirree istaadiyoomii idil-addunyaa Dubaay kan biyya Emireetota Arabaa Gamtoomaniitti. Taphi kunis yeroo Dubaay sa'aatii 6:30 galgala irratti kan jalqabu ta'a.

title: Mudslide in eastern China kills one, leaves 11 missing
english: A severe mudslide caused by persistent heavy rainfall in China's Jiangxi province has resulted in one death and left 11 people missing. Emergency responders have successfully recovered three survivors from the debris. Authorities continue to caution local residents as the threat of flooding remains high.
amharic: በቻይና ጂያንሺ ግዛት ለቀናት በዘለቀው ከባድ ዝናብ ምክንያት በተፈጠረ የመሬት መንሸራተት አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ 11 ሰዎች ደግሞ የት እንደደረሱ አልታወቀም። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ሶስት ሰዎችን ከጭቃው ስር በህይወት ማውጣት ችለዋል። ባለስልጣናት የጎርፍ አደጋ ስጋት አሁንም ስላለ ህዝቡ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርግ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaa Chaayinaa naannoo Jiangxi keessatti rooba cimaa guyyoota hedduuf robeen mudatee tureen lafti ishee sigigsuun nama tokko ajjeeseera, namoonni 11 immoo bakka buutee isaanii hin beekamu. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa namoota sadii gubbee lafaatii lubbuun baasuu danda'aniiru. Bulchiinsi naannichaa sodaan balaa lolaa ammas waan jiruuf ummanni of eeggannoo cimaa akka godhu akeekkachiiseera.

title: At least 5 killed in Russian attacks on Ukraine as US envoys visit Moscow
english: A Russian strike on the Ukrainian city of Kamianske resulted in at least five deaths and several injuries, despite a reported three-day ceasefire intended to allow for diplomatic peace talks. US envoys have arrived in Moscow and Kyiv to propose a plan to end the conflict. Meanwhile, the International Atomic Energy Agency has secured a separate, localized ceasefire to repair power lines at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant.
amharic: በዩክሬን ካሚያንኬ ከተማ በደረሰ የሩሲያ ጥቃት ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ሌሎች አምስት ሰዎች ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የተፈጸመው የሰላም ንግግሮችን ለማመቻቸት በተቀመጠ የሶስት ቀን የተኩስ አቁም ጊዜ ውስጥ ቢሆንም ነው። የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማቶች ጦርነቱን ለማስቆም በሞስኮ እና በኪየቭ ጉብኝት እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በተመሳሳይ የኑክሌር ጣቢያን የኤሌክትሪክ መስመር ለመጠገን የተለየ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ተደርጓል።
oromo: Magaalaa Yukreen Kaamiyaankee keessatti haleellaa Raashiyaan gaggeessiteen namoonni shan yoo du'an, kaan immoo miidhamaniiru. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame yeroo lolli dhaabbachuu qabu jedhamee guyyaa sadiif labsame keessa dha. Bakka bu'oonni Ameerikaa waraana kana xumuruuf Moskoo fi Kiyivitti marii kan gaggeessaa jiran yoo ta'u, buufata niwuukilaraa Zaapooriizhiyaa keessatti ibsaa deebisuuf immoo walii galteen dhaabbii lolaa adda ta'e tokko taasifameera.

title: Why is Trump threatening to strike Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain again, now?
english: President Donald Trump has renewed his threats to launch a military strike against Iran's fortified Pickaxe Mountain nuclear facility. This warning follows a recent US missile attack on an Iranian oil tanker near Kharg Island amid ongoing regional tensions. While the administration downplays the severity of the conflict, the lack of progress in nuclear negotiations has kept military risks high.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን በሚገኘው የፒክአክስ ማውንቴን የኑክሌር ማዕከል ላይ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት እንደሚሰነዝሩ ዳግም አስፈራሩ። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰማው በአካባቢው ውጥረት እየጨመረ ባለበት ወቅት በአሜሪካ ኃይሎች በካርግ ደሴት አቅራቢያ በኢራን የነዳጅ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ነው። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ግጭቱን ቀላል ቢመስልም የኑክሌር ድርድር አለመሳካቱ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን የጦርነት ስጋት ከፍ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaard Tiraamp buufata niwukilaraa Iiraan kan ta'e Pickaxe Mountain irratti weerara waraanaa gaggeessuu akka danda'an marakachuu isaanii irra deebin ibsaniiru. Doorsisni kun kan dhufe, yeroo waraanni naannichatti hammaataa jiru kana, markaba boba'aa Iiraan kan ta'e kan ganda Kharg biratti haleelame boodadha. Mootummaan Tiraamp walitti bu'iinsa kana salphisee ilaaluuf yaaluus, mariin niwukilaraa bu'aa dhabuun isaa soda waraanaa kana dabalee jira.

title: US ambassador to Israel meets Palestinian-Americans in occupied West Bank
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee recently traveled to Turmus Ayya in the occupied West Bank. During his visit, he met with local Palestinian-American residents and community leaders. The trip took place against a backdrop of escalating tensions and frequent attacks by Israeli settlers in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካው አምባሳደር በእስራኤል ማይክ ሀካቢ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ክፍል ወደምትገኘው ቱርሙስ አያ ከተማ ተጉዘዋል። በጉብኝታቸውም ከአካባቢው የፍልስጤም አሜሪካውያን ነዋሪዎች እና ከኃላፊዎች ጋር ተወያይተዋል። ጉብኝቱ የተካሄደው በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ ባለው የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት እና ውጥረት መካከል ነው።
oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa gara Israa'el Maayik Haakaabii gara magaalaa Turmus Ayya kan naannoo Waa'ii Bangee (West Bank) qabamee jiruutti imaluudhaan jiraattotaa fi hoogganoota Falasxiim-Ameerikaa waliin mari'ataniiru. Imalli kun kan ta'e yeroo naannicha keessatti haleellaan warra lafa qabatanii jiran irra deddeebi'ee mudachaa jiru fi waldhabdee guddaan jiru kanatti.

title: Ethiopia’s Future Demands Axum–Harar Synergy
english: Ethiopian civilization is defined by the interaction between two major historical centers: the northern Christian highlands of Axum and the eastern Islamic trading hub of Harar. While many diverse ethnic groups have contributed to the country's development, these two regions represent enduring symbols of institutional and cultural history. Recognizing both traditions as complementary pillars is essential to understanding the full complexity of Ethiopia's heritage.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ስልጣኔ በሰሜኑ የአክሱም ክርስቲያናዊ ማዕከል እና በምስራቁ የሐረር እስላማዊ የንግድ ማዕከል መካከል ባለው ግንኙነት የተቃኘ ነው። ብዙ ብሄረሰቦች ለሀገሪቱ እድገት አስተዋጽኦ ቢያደርጉም፣ እነዚህ ሁለት አካባቢዎች የረዥም ጊዜ ታሪካዊ እና ባህላዊ ተቋማት ምልክቶች ናቸው። የሁለቱንም የባህል ስሮች እንደ ሀገር ዋና መሰረት አድርጎ መውሰድ የኢትዮጵያን አጠቃላይ ታሪክ ለመረዳት ወሳኝ ነው።
oromo: Siivilizeeshiniin Itoophiyaa guddinaa fi seenaa isaa keessatti bu’uura Axum fi Harar irratti kan hundaa’e dha. Saboonni fi sab-lammoonni Itoophiyaa hedduun biyya kana ijaaruu keessatti gahee qabaatanis, Axum fi Harar akka mallattoo seenaa fi aadaa cimaatti fudhatamu. Aadaa fi seenaa naannoo lamaan kana walitti fiduun Itoophiyaa fiixaan baatee beekuuf murteessaa dha.

title: Niger accuses France of orchestrating failed military mutiny
english: The military government of Niger has officially accused France of supporting a failed mutiny attempt that took place at an important airbase in the capital city. These allegations follow recent violent confrontations between the ruling junta and soldiers who tried to seize power. This event marks another point of tension between the current administration and the French government.
amharic: የኒጀር ወታደራዊ አስተዳደር ባለፈው ሳምንት በዋና ከተማዋ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ የአየር ማረፊያ ላይ የተደረገው መፈንቅለ መንግስት ሙከራ ከፈረንሳይ ድጋፍ የተደረገለት እንደሆነ ከሷል። ይህ ክስ የቀረበው የገዢው ጁንታ እና ስልጣን ለመያዝ የሞከሩ ወታደሮች በተጋጩበት ወቅት ነው። ክስተቱ በኒጀር አገዛዝ እና በፈረንሳይ መንግስት መካከል ያለውን ውጥረት አባብሶታል።
oromo: Mootummaan waraanaa biyya Niijer, kutaala magaalaa guddoo ishee keessatti argamu irratti ka'ee ture garuu milkaa'uu hin dandeenye, mootummaa Faransaay qindeessuun akka raawwatame himate. Himannaan kun kan dhufe erga waraanni mootummaa fi loltoonni aangoo irraa buusuu barbaadan walitti bu'anii booda. Ta'een kun hariiroo mootummaa amma aangoorra jiruufi biyya Faransaay gidduu jiru kan caalaatti jabeessu ta'a.

title: Alcaraz, Sabalenka into US Open last 16 as Williams sisters lose on return
english: Defending champions Carlos Alcaraz and Aryna Sabalenka have successfully advanced to the round of 16 at the US Open after winning their respective singles matches. While these stars continued their strong performance in the tournament, tennis legends Serena and Venus Williams faced a difficult loss during their highly anticipated return to doubles competition. Alcaraz is set to play Tommy Paul next, while Sabalenka will face Taylor Townsend in the upcoming round.
amharic: የዩኤስ ኦፕን አሸናፊዎች ካርሎስ አልካራስ እና አሪና ሳባሌንካ በየክፍላቸው ተጋጣሚዎችን በማሸነፍ ወደ ቀጣዩ ዙር አልፈዋል። የቴኒስ ኮከቦች የሆኑት ሴሬና እና ቪነስ ዊሊያምስ ከረጅም ጊዜ በኋላ በጥምረት ወደ ውድድር ቢመለሱም፣ በሚያሳዝን ሁኔታ ሽንፈትን አስተናግደዋል። አልካራስ ቀጥሎ ከቶሚ ፖል ጋር የሚጫወት ሲሆን ሳባሌንካ ደግሞ ከቴይለር ታውንሰንድ ጋር የምትገናኝ ይሆናል።
oromo: Injifattoonni waggaa darbee Kaarlos Alkaaraz fi Ariinaa Saabaaleenkaas tapha gita isaanii injifachuun gara sadarkaa 16ffaa US Open darbeera. Yeroo kanaan taphattoonni beekamoon akkasumas obboloonni Wiiliyaams, Seereenaa fi Viinas, erga waggaa dheeraa booda tapha cimdii irratti deebi'anii hirmaatanii injifatamaniiru. Alkaaraz fuulduratti Toomii Pool waliin kan taphatu yoo ta'u, Saabaaleenkaas ammoo Teeylar Taawunsand waliin kan morkattu ta'a.

title: Have scientists discovered a dark matter particle?
english: Researchers in a South Dakota laboratory have detected a mysterious particle interaction that might finally offer clues about dark matter, the invisible substance believed to hold the universe together. While this finding is not yet a confirmed discovery, it represents a significant step in understanding the vast portion of space that remains unseen. To further explore these hidden cosmic forces, NASA is also preparing to launch a specialized telescope dedicated to studying dark matter and dark energy.
amharic: በደቡብ ዳኮታ የሚገኙ ሳይንቲስቶች አጽናፈ ሰማይን በአንድነት እንደያዘ በሚታመነው 'ጨለማ ቁስ' (dark matter) ላይ ጥናት ሲያደርጉ ያልተለመደ የንጥል እንቅስቃሴ ማግኘታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ግኝት ገና በይፋ ያልተረጋገጠ ቢሆንም፣ እስከ አሁን ድረስ በምስጢር የተሸፈነውን የአጽናፈ ሰማይ ክፍል ለመረዳት ትልቅ እርምጃ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። የጨለማ ቁስ እና የጨለማ ጉልበትን ምስጢር ለመፍታት ናሳ ልዩ ቴሌስኮፕ ለመላክ እየተዘጋጀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Qorattoonni lafa jala, kutaa South Dakota, Ameerikaa jiru keessatti, ragaa 'dark matter' ykn meeshaa ifa hin qabne kan addunyaa wal qabsiisu jedhamee yaadamu irratti mallattoo haaraa argatan. Wanti kun ammayyuu guutummaatti mirkanaa'uu baatus, hubannoo keenya kan addunyaa ifaan mul'atuu ala jiruuf tarkaanfii guddaadha. NASA'n guddina kana qorachuufis, telescope addaa kan 'dark matter' fi 'dark energy' irratti xiyyeeffatu erguuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: At least five killed in Sudan’s South Kordofan in attack by rebel group
english: Rebel forces from the SPLM-N have launched artillery attacks on residential areas in Sudan's South Kordofan province, resulting in at least 26 deaths including children. The medical group reporting these incidents warned that the violence is worsening the humanitarian crisis and specifically targeting minority groups in the Nuba Mountains. These assaults continue despite ceasefire efforts, further complicating the ongoing conflict between Sudan's military and paramilitary factions.
amharic: የኤስ.ፒ.ኤል.ኤም-ኤን አማፂ ቡድን በሱዳን ደቡብ ኮርዶፋን ግዛት በሚኖሩ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ላይ ባደረሰው የከባድ መሳሪያ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 26 ሰዎች መሞታቸውን የህክምና ባለሙያዎች አስታወቁ። በጥቃቱ ህፃናትን ጨምሮ ንፁሃን መገደላቸው እና የተፈናቀሉ ሰዎች ቁጥር መጨመሩ የሰብአዊ ቀውሱን ይበልጥ እንዳባባሰው ተገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት በሀገሪቱ እየተካሄደ ካለው የርስ በርስ ጦርነት ጎን ለጎን የዘር ግጭትንም በማስከተል ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni finxaaleyyiin SPLM-N jedhamu naannoo Kordofaanii Kibbaa Sudaanitti namoota nagaa irratti haleellaa raawwateen lubbuun namoota 26 ol darbeera. Gareen ogeeyyii fayyaa akka ibsetti, haleellaan kun daran baay'ee fi miidhaa guddaa geessisuun isaa rakkoo namoomaa biyyattii keessatti babal'atee jiru daran hammaachiseera. Haleellaan kun gamtaan dhaabbata biyyoota gamtoomaniis ta'e carraaqqiin tasgabii biyyattii keessatti taasifamaa jiru osoo jiruu kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, gidduu galeessatti sanyii irratti xiyyeeffate ta'uunis himameera.

title: Bolivian military barracks explosion kills at least 10
english: A tragic explosion occurred at a military base in Viacha, Bolivia, resulting in at least 10 fatalities. The blast was caused by a cache of fireworks and pyrotechnics stored at the facility. Numerous other people were left injured following the incident.
amharic: ቦሊቪያ በሚገኘው የቪያቻ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ ውስጥ በተከሰተ የፍንዳታ አደጋ ቢያንስ 10 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ፍንዳታው በካምፑ ውስጥ ተከማችተው በነበሩ ርችቶች እና ተያያዥ ቁሳቁሶች ምክንያት የተፈጠረ ነው። በዚህ አደጋ ምክንያት በርካታ ሰዎችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Buufata waraanaa Viacha, Boliviyaa keessatti balaa dhohuu mudateen namoonni yoo xiqqaate 10 du’aniiru. Dhohiinsi kun meeshaalee ibiddaa (fireworks) buufatichatti kuufamanii turan irraa kan madde dha. Balaa kanaan namoonni hedduun ammoo miidhamaniiru.

title: UN says Israeli settler violence in West Bank displaced 2,500 Palestinians in 2026
english: The United Nations reports that settler violence in the occupied West Bank has forced 2,500 Palestinians to abandon their homes this year, with children accounting for half of those affected. Since 2023, these attacks and movement restrictions have displaced over 6,400 people and completely emptied dozens of Palestinian communities. Aid groups warn that this ongoing trend is causing a worsening humanitarian crisis due to the destruction of property and loss of access to essential services.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በምዕራብ ባንክ በሚኖሩ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች የሚፈጸም ጥቃት በዘንድሮው ዓመት ብቻ 2,500 ፍልስጤማውያንን ከመኖሪያቸው እንዳፈናቀለ ገልጿል፤ ከተፈናቃዮቹ መካከል ግማሾቹ ህጻናት ናቸው። ከ2023 ጀምሮ በተከሰቱ ተመሳሳይ ጥቃቶች እና የመንቀሳቀስ ገደቦች ከ6,400 በላይ ሰዎች መፈናቀላቸውን እና በርካታ መንደሮች ባዶ እንደቀሩ ተጠቁሟል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተቋማት ይህ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃት እና የመሠረተ ልማት ውድመት በአካባቢው የከፋ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ እየፈጠረ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka gabaasetti, weerara naannawaa Lixa Baankiitti raawwatameen bara kana qofa namoonni Pilaasxiin 2,500 ta'an qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru; isaan keessaa walakkaan isaanii ijoollee dha. Bara 2023 irraa eegalee, weerara kanaafi uggura sochii kanaan walqabatee namoonni 6,400 ol ta'an buqqa'anii, gandoonni Pilaasxiin hedduun guutummaatti duwwaa ta'aniiru. Gareewwan gargaarsaa akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun fi mancaatiin qabeenyaa, namoota irratti miidhaa hamaa qaqqabsiisuun rakkoo namoomaa daran hammaataa akka jiru akeekkachisaniiru.

title: 55 bodies, remains of Malka family recovered from rubble in Gaza's Zeytoun
english: Rescue teams in Gaza City's Zeytoun neighborhood recently discovered the bodies of 55 members of the Malka family trapped under building wreckage. These individuals had been missing since they sought shelter in the structure during an Israeli bombardment two years ago. Authorities plan to hold a collective funeral for the victims early next week.
amharic: በጋዛ ከተማ ዘይቱን አካባቢ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ከፈራረሰው ህንጻ ስር የ55 የማልካ ቤተሰብ አባላትን አስከሬን አግኝተዋል። እነዚህ ሰዎች ከሁለት አመት በፊት በእስራኤል የቦምብ ጥቃት ወቅት መጠለያ ፍለጋ ወደ ህንጻው ገብተው እንደነበር ተገልጿል። ለሟቾች የቀብር ስነ ስርዓት በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት መጀመሪያ ላይ በጋራ እንደሚፈጸም ባለስልጣናት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Magaala Gaaza keessatti gareewwan gargaarsa namoomaa reeffa miseensota maatii Malka 55 ta'an, iddoo ijaarsi tokko caccabe jala irraa argataniiru. Namoonni kunneen waggoota lama dura yeroo haleellaan rooba boombii geggeeffame sana baqachuuf gara ijaarsichaa seenanii turan. Qaamoleen aango qaban immoo, torbee dhufu jalqaba irratti reeffa namoota kanaaf sirni awwaalchaa waloo akka godhamu beeksisaniiru.

title: Morning recap
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated as Iran threatens preemptive action against perceived threats, while Western powers push for a UN Security Council resolution regarding Iran's nuclear activities. Meanwhile, Israeli airstrikes in Lebanon resulted in several casualties, and the U.S. approved a multi-billion dollar arms sale to Saudi Arabia. Additionally, regional maritime traffic has significantly declined, and internal security investigations are underway within the U.S. military regarding information leaks.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ኢራን በራሷ ላይ ስጋት የሆኑ ነገሮች ሲያጋጥሙ አስቀድማ እንደምትወስድ አስታውቃለች፤ ምዕራባውያን ሀገራትም የኢራንን የኑክሌር እንቅስቃሴ ለተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት ለማቅረብ እየሰሩ ነው። በሌላ በኩል እስራኤል በሊባኖስ ባደረሰችው ጥቃት የሰው ህይወት የጠፋ ሲሆን አሜሪካም ለሳውዲ አረቢያ የጦር መሳሪያ ለመሸጥ ተስማምታለች። ከዚህም በተጨማሪ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ የሚደረገው የመርከብ ጉዞ በግማሽ ቀንሷል፤ በአሜሪካ ጦር ውስጥም ስለ ጦርነቱ መረጃ መፍሰስን ተከትሎ ምርመራዎች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛል።
oromo: Giddugaleessa Bahaatti waraanniifi waldhabdeen dabaluu isaa hordofee, Iraan sodaachisa kamiyyuu dura dhaabbachuuf tarkaanfii fudhachuuf akka qophoofte ibsiteetti; biyyoonni lixaa immoo waa'ee hojii niwukilaaraa Iraan irratti gabaasa gara Mana Maree Nageenyaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomaniitti ergachuuf yaalii gochaa jiru. Gammachuu biraatiin, haleellaan Israa'el Libaanoos irratti raawwatte lubbuu namaa galaafateera, akkasumas Ameerikaan Sa'udii Arabiyaaf meeshaa waraanaa gurguruuf waliigaltee mallatteessiteetti. Kana malees, daandii galaana Hormuz irratti sochiin doonii hir'achuu isaa fi waraana Ameerikaa keessatti oduu icciitii ta'e baasuun walqabatee qorannoon gaggeeffamaa jiraachuun ibsameera.

title: West Bank violence: Israeli forces open fire during raid, settlers vandalise home
english: Israeli military forces conducted several raids across the West Bank, resulting in arrests and the seizure of a large area of Palestinian land for construction purposes. Meanwhile, settlers damaged private property and harassed residents in various communities. These coordinated actions have further escalated tensions in the region, including the sealing off of a village and violent confrontations in a refugee camp.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባደረጉት ተከታታይ ወረራ በርካታ ግለሰቦችን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉ ሲሆን ለግንባታ የሚሆን ሰፊ መሬትም ቀምተዋል። በተመሳሳይ ጊዜ፣ ሰፋሪዎች የግል ንብረቶችን በማውደም እና ነዋሪዎችን በማወክ ግጭቱን አባብሰዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በበርካታ አካባቢዎች የነዋሪዎችን እንቅስቃሴ በመገደብ እና የፀጥታ ቀውሱን በማባባስ የክልሉን ሁኔታ አደገኛ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda West Bank keessatti qarqaba godhaniin namoota hedduu hidhatti kan guuran yoo ta'u, lafa bal'aa kanneen biroo ijaarsaaf qabataniru. Gamatti, qonnaan bultoonni (settlers) qabeenya dhuunfaa mancaasuun fi ummata nagaa irratti gidiraa geessisuun waldhabdee uumaniru. Gochootni kunneen sochii ummataa daangeessuufi naannicha keessatti jeequmsa uumuun haalli nageenyaa akka hammaatu godheera.

title: Iran urges regional nations to build 'homegrown' security architecture
english: Iranian official Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf has called for Middle Eastern countries to establish their own independent security systems rather than relying on external powers. This proposal aligns with recent remarks by Chinese President Xi Jinping at an SCO summit, where he advocated for universal regional security and opposed foreign dominance. Iran has expressed its willingness to collaborate with neighboring states to foster this new, self-reliant stability.
amharic: የኢራኑ የፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ፣ የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ አገራት በውጭ ኃይሎች ላይ ከመታመን ይልቅ የራሳቸውን ገለልተኛ የደህንነት ሥርዓት እንዲገነቡ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ ሃሳብ በቅርቡ በሻንጋይ ትብብር ድርጅት ጉባኤ ላይ የቻይናው ፕሬዚዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ ካነሱት አህጉራዊ የጋራ ደህንነት እና የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነትን የመቃወም አቋም ጋር የሚጣጣም ነው። ኢራን ከጎረቤት አገራት ጋር በመተባበር ይህንን የራሳቸውን አቅም ያማከለ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር ዝግጁ መሆኗን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Iran naannichi nageenya isaa eeggachuuf humnoota alaa irraa bilisa ta’ee, sirna nageenyaa mataa isaa akka diriirfatu gaafataniiru. Yaanni kun kan walsimuuf ibsa pirezidaant Si Jiinpiing kan Chaayinaa, yaa'ii dhaabbata waliigaltee Shaanghaay irratti nageenya naannichaa of danda'ee kabajamuu qaba jechuun kennan waliini. Iran naannicha keessatti nageenya tasgabbaa’aa fi of danda’e uumuuf biyyoota ollaa wajjin hojjechuuf qophiidha.

title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
english: The United Nations has passed a resolution to replace the traditional Mercator world map with a more accurate version that reflects Africa's true size. For centuries, the Mercator projection has significantly distorted geography by making countries near the equator appear much smaller than they actually are. Supported by the African Union, this change aims to correct long-standing biases and ensure that the scale of continents is represented fairly in global institutions.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት የአፍሪካን ትክክለኛ ስፋት የሚያሳይ አዲስ የአለም ካርታ እንዲጠቀም ድምጽ ሰጥቷል። ለብዙ ዘመናት ጥቅም ላይ የዋለው የሜርኬተር ካርታ በተለይም በኢኳቶር አቅራቢያ ያሉ አገሮችን መጠን በማሳነስ ትክክለኛ ያልሆነ ምስል ሲሰጥ ቆይቷል። በአፍሪካ ህብረት የተደገፈው ይህ ውሳኔ፣ ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የተዛቡ አመለካከቶችን ለማስተካከል እና አህጉራት በካርታ ላይ ትክክለኛ መጠናቸውን እንዲያንፀባርቁ ለማድረግ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Tokkummaan Mootummootaa kaartaa addunyaa kan durii jijjiiree, guddina biyya Afrikaa kan sirriitti ibsu kaartaa haaraa akka fayyadamu sagalee kenneera. Kaartaan 'Mercator' jedhamu kan jaarraawwan hedduuf itti fayyadamaa turre, biyyoota guddina isaanii xiqqeessuun akka mul'atan waan godhuuf komatamaa ture. Kaartaan haaraan kun tokkummaa Afrikaatiin kan deggerame yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas dogoggora kaartaa durii sirreessuun, biyyoonni fi sadarkaan isaanii akka sirriitti addunyaatti beekamu gochuudha.

title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
english: A powerful explosion involving pyrotechnic materials occurred at a military base in Viacha, Bolivia, resulting in at least two confirmed deaths and dozens of injuries. Local authorities report significant damage to nearby residential properties and are currently investigating the exact cause of the blast. Due to the risk of secondary explosions, emergency crews have established a safety perimeter, and the town has entered a three-day mourning period.

title: UN approves new map showing Africa’s true size
english: The United Nations General Assembly has passed a resolution to adopt new world maps that provide a more accurate representation of Africa's actual size. Critics argue that the traditional Mercator projection, which has been used for centuries, significantly distorts the scale of countries and misleads global perceptions. By updating these maps, the UN aims to correct these historical inaccuracies and reflect a more realistic view of the continent.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ የአፍሪካን እውነተኛ ስፋት የሚያሳይ አዲስ የዓለም ካርታ እንዲተገበር ወስኗል። ለዘመናት ጥቅም ላይ የዋለው የሜርካተር ካርታ የአገራትን ስፋት በተሳሳተ መንገድ በማሳየት የተዛባ ግንዛቤ እንዲፈጠር ማድረጉን ደጋፊዎች ይናገራሉ። ይህ አዲስ እርምጃ በካርታዎች ላይ የነበረውን የታሪክ ስህተት በማረም አህጉሪቱን በተጨባጭ መጠኗ ለማሳየት ያለመ ነው።

Tarkaanfiin kun dogoggora durii sirreessuun Afrikaa guddina ishee dhugaatiin agarsiisuuf gumaacha.

title: Blasts at Bolivian military base kill at least 10, injure dozens
english: At least ten people have died and dozens were injured following two massive explosions at a military facility in Viacha, Bolivia, used to store pyrotechnics. Local officials report that seven individuals remain missing, while nearby homes were severely damaged by the force of the blasts. Authorities are currently investigating the cause of the incident and have warned residents to stay clear of the site due to ongoing safety risks.
amharic: በቦሊቪያ ቪያቻ ከተማ በሚገኝ ወታደራዊ ካምፕ ውስጥ በተከሰቱ ሁለት ኃይለኛ ፍንዳታዎች ቢያንስ አስር ሰዎች መሞታቸው እና በደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ መቁሰላቸው ተነግሯል። በፍንዳታው ሳቢያ ሰባት ሰዎች የት እንዳሉ ያልታወቀ ሲሆን በአካባቢው የሚገኙ በርካታ ቤቶችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት የፍንዳታውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን ተጨማሪ ፍንዳታ ሊኖር ስለሚችል ነዋሪዎች ከቦታው እንዲርቁ ተመክሯል።
oromo: Magala Viacha kan Boliiviyaa keessatti buufata waraanaa tokko keessatti xaxaa ibiddaa kuufamee ture keessatti dhuka'a lama mudateen lubbuun namoota kudhan darbeera, hedduun isaanii ammoo miidhamaniiru. title: Malaysia declares emergency in Sarawak as haze from Indonesia worsens
english: Malaysia has declared a state of emergency in the Serian district of Sarawak due to dangerous levels of air pollution caused by Indonesian wildfires. This measure includes closing hundreds of schools, government offices, and construction sites to protect public health. Authorities are also performing cloud-seeding operations to help clear the thick smog that is currently affecting several countries across Southeast Asia.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ እየተከሰተ ባለው የደን ቃጠሎ ምክንያት የተፈጠረው ከፍተኛ የአየር ብክለት ሳቢያ ማሌዥያ በሳራዋክ ግዛት በምትገኝ የሴሪያን ዲስትሪክት የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ አውጃለች። የህዝብን ጤንነት ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ትምህርት ቤቶች፣ የመንግስት ቢሮዎች እና የግንባታ ቦታዎች እንዲዘጉ ተደርጓል። ባለስልጣናት አካባቢውን የተዋጠውን ጭስ ለመቀነስ ደመናን የመዝራት ስራ እያከናወኑ ሲሆን፣ ችግሩ በሌሎች የደቡብ ምስራቅ እስያ ሀገራት ላይም ተፅዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Maalaysiyaan sababa ibidda bosonaa Indoneezhiyaatti ka’een qilleensi naannoo Seriyaan, Saaraawaak faallamee haala sodaachisaa irra ga’uun, naannichatti labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labsiteetti. title: Did Israel’s destruction of Gaza worsen its water crisis?
english: Experts suggest that the destruction of Gaza’s sewage infrastructure has led to a significant algae bloom in the Mediterranean Sea. This environmental issue has disrupted the operations of five out of six desalination plants in Israel. Consequently, the country is now facing a severe water supply crisis as it relies heavily on these facilities for fresh water.
amharic: የጋዛ የፍሳሽ ማስወገጃ ሥርዓት መውደም በመካከለኛው ምድር ባህር ውስጥ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የአልጌ መራባት አስከትሏል ሲሉ ሳይንቲስቶች ይገልጻሉ። ይህ የአካባቢ ችግር በእስራኤል ከሚገኙ ስድስት የውኃ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያዎች መካከል አምስቱን አገልግሎት እንዳይሰጡ አድርጓቸዋል። በአገሪቱ የውኃ አቅርቦት ላይ በእነዚህ ጣቢያዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥገኛ በመሆናቸው፣ አሁን ከባድ የውኃ እጥረት አጋጥሟቸዋል።

title: Trump sends envoys to Russia, Ukraine with new peace plan
english: President Donald Trump has dispatched representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to Moscow and Kyiv to present a fresh initiative for resolving the ongoing conflict. This peace proposal focuses on establishing a ceasefire and providing security assurances to Ukraine. The mission marks a significant effort by the Trump administration to find a path toward ending the hostilities.

title: US, allies push IAEA board to report Iran to UN Security Council
english: The United States and several European allies are pushing for the IAEA to refer Iran to the UN Security Council due to its failure to cooperate with investigations into undeclared uranium sites. This move follows previous tensions regarding Iran's enrichment activities and restricted access for international inspectors. If the resolution is approved, it would mark the first time in two decades that the board has escalated the issue to the Security Council.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና አጋሮቿ ኢራን ባልታወቁ ቦታዎች ላይ በተገኙ የዩራኒየም ምልክቶች ምርመራ ባለመተባበሯ ጉዳዩን ወደ የተባበሩት መንግስታት የጸጥታው ምክር ቤት እንዲመራ እየገፋፉ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ ኢራን በኒውክሌር እንቅስቃሴዋ ላይ አለም አቀፍ ተቆጣጣሪዎችን በመከልከሏ የመጣ ነው። ይህም በሁለት አስርት ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ጉዳዩ ወደ ምክር ቤቱ እንዲሸጋገር የሚያደርግ ነው።

title: Gulf of Oman sees ship-to-ship transfer of 24 million barrels of crude
english: On Friday, maritime monitoring services observed 17 separate ship-to-ship transfers involving 24 million barrels of oil and gas in the Gulf of Oman. The area has become heavily congested with tankers waiting for opportunities to offload their cargo. Additional vessels are currently moving through the Strait of Hormuz under security protection to join the active trading fleet.
amharic: በኦማን ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ አርብ ዕለት 17 የተለያዩ መርከቦች 24 ሚሊዮን በርሜል ድፍድፍ ነዳጅና ጋዝ ተቀያይረዋል። በስፍራው የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከቦች መጨናነቅ በመፈጠሩ፣ ሌሎች መርከቦችም እቃቸውን ለማራገፍ ተራ እየጠበቁ ይገኛሉ። በተጨማሪም ተጨማሪ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መርከቦች በአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ጥበቃ ስር የሆርሙዝን የባህር መተላለፊያ አቋርጠው ወደ አካባቢው እየገቡ ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa Jimaata darbe, markaboonni 17 ta'an ganda Omaan keessatti baarmila miiliyona 24 kan ta'u boba'aa fi gaazii wal jijjiiranii jiru. title: Iran army says US bid to weaken its Hormuz control answered 'within 15 minutes'
english: A senior Iranian military official claims that Iran responded to a U.S. strike on Sirik Island by launching missiles and drones at four American bases within 15 minutes. The official stated that these AI-equipped weapons were difficult to intercept and hit their targets successfully as part of Iran’s new focus on preemptive military operations. Iran maintains that these actions are defensive measures and has warned that any future threats will be met with immediate and decisive force.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን እንደገለፁት፣ ኢራን በሲሪክ ደሴት ላይ በተፈፀመባት የአሜሪካ ጥቃት ምላሽ ለመስጠት በ15 ደቂቃ ውስጥ አራት የአሜሪካን የጦር ሰፈሮች በሮኬቶች እና በድሮኖች መታች። ባለስልጣኑ እነዚህ ሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት ያላቸው መሳሪያዎች ለመከላከል አስቸጋሪ እንደነበሩ እና ኢራን በቅድመ-መከላከል ስልቶቿ ላይ ያላትን ቁርጠኝነት ያሳዩ እንደነበር ገልጸዋል። ኢራን ድርጊቷን እንደ መከላከያ እርምጃ የምትወስደው ሲሆን፣ ወደፊት ለሚመጡ ማናቸውም ስጋቶች ፈጣን እና ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Hogganaan waraana Iraan tokko akka jedhutti, Iraan buufata Sirik irratti weerara Ameerikaatiin ishee irra gaheef daqiiqaa 15 keessatti raaketaa fi roonoota fayyadamuun buufataalee waraana Ameerikaa afuritti haleellaa raawwatteetti. Hojjetichi akka ibsetti, meeshaaleen kun teeknoolojii AI fayyadamuufi ittisuuf ulfaataa akka turan ibsuun, Iraan tarkaanfii duraa fudhachuuf karoora qabatte keessatti qabxii gurguddoo akka ta'an dubbateera. Iraan tarkaanfiin kun of-ittisuuf kan fudhatame akka ta'e himuun, gara fuulduraatti dhaadannoo kamiyyuu irratti deebii hatattamaa fi murannoo qabu akka kennitu akeekkachiisteetti.

title: NYT: 50 US Joint Staff members take polygraph test over Iran war leaks
english: Around 50 members of the U.S. Joint Staff were recently subjected to lie detector tests by government investigators. The inquiry follows media reports that revealed classified information regarding declining U.S. weapon supplies during the conflict with Iran. The Pentagon has not addressed specific details of the investigation but emphasized that it treats the unauthorized disclosure of national security information as a very serious matter.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት መርማሪዎች ከኢራን ጋር በተፈጠረው ግጭት ወቅት ስለተከሰተው የጦር መሳሪያ እጥረት ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎችን ለጋዜጠኞች አሳልፈው ሰጥተዋል በሚል ጥርጣሬ፣ ወደ 50 የሚጠጉ የጋራ ስታፍ አባላትን የውሸት ማወቂያ ምርመራ እንዲያደርጉ አድርገዋል። እነዚህ ምርመራዎች የተካሄዱት ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎች ለፕሬስ መለቀቃቸውን ለማረጋገጥ ነው። የፔንታጎን ቃል አቀባይ ጉዳዩን በተመለከተ ዝርዝር አስተያየት ከመስጠት ቢቆጠቡም፣ የሀገር ደህንነትን የሚመለከቱ ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎች መፍሰስ ከፍተኛ ስጋት እንደሚፈጥር ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Qorattoonni mootummaa Ameerikaa miseensota waraanaa 50 ol ta'an irratti qormaata dhugaa baatuu gaggeessaniiru. Qorannoon kun kan godhame, waa'ee hir'ina meeshaalee waraanaa Ameerikaa kan Iran waliin walqabatu oduu miidiyaalee irratti ba'uu hordofee dha. Qaamni Pentagon-is qorannoo kana irratti ibsa bal'aa kennuu baatus, odeeffannoo nageenya biyyaa eeguun dirqama akka ta'eefi gadi lakkifamuun isaas dhimma cimaa akka ta'e ibseera.

title: Iranian army spokesman says US, Israel 'failed' to achieve war objectives
english: A senior Iranian military official claims that recent US and Israeli attacks against Iran were a complete failure. He stated that these nations misjudged Iran’s military strength and domestic stability, failing to destroy its nuclear facilities or cause political collapse. Furthermore, he noted that the attackers underestimated Iran’s strategic influence over the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን በቅርቡ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል በኢራን ላይ የተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ሙሉ በሙሉ መክሸፋቸውን ገለጹ። እነዚህ ሀገራት የኢራንን ወታደራዊ አቅም እና የውስጥ መረጋጋት በተሳሳተ መንገድ በመገመታቸው የኒውክሌር ማዕከላትዋን ለማውደም ወይም መንግሥቷን ለመጣል ያቀዱት እቅድ እንዳልተሳካ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ አጥቂዎቹ ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ላይ ያላትን ስትራቴጂያዊ ተጽዕኖ አቅልለው መመልከታቸውን ጠቅሰዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan akka jedhanitti, haleellaan yeroo dhihoo as biyyoota Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irraa Iraan irratti gaggeeffame guutummaatti fashaleera. Biyyoonni kun humna waraanaa Iraan dogoggoran waan hubataniif, dhaabbilee niwukilaraa ishee balleessuu fi mootummaa ishee buusuuf kan karoorfatan milkaa'uu hin dandeenye jedhaniiru. Kana malees, weerartoonni sun dhiibbaa Iraan qarqara galaana Hormuz irratti qabdu akka laayyootti ilaaluun isaanii isaaniif dogoggora guddaa ta'uu himaniiru.

title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
english: A Massachusetts judge has declared a mistrial in the case of Lindsay Clancy after the jury could not reach a unanimous verdict regarding the murder of her three young children. Although Clancy admits to the killings, her defense team argues she was experiencing postpartum psychosis at the time and should not be held legally responsible. The 36-year-old former nurse will remain in a mental health facility while prosecutors determine whether to pursue a new trial or reach a settlement.
amharic: ሊንዚ ክላንሲ ሶስት ትናንሽ ልጆቿን በመግደሏ የቀረበባት ክስ ዳኞች በአንድነት መወሰን ባለመቻላቸው ዳኛው ክሱ እንዲቋረጥ ወስነዋል። ተከሳሡ ልጆቹን እንደገደለች ብታምንም፣ ጠበቆቿ በወቅቱ ከወሊድ በኋላ የሚከሰት የአእምሮ ህመም (postpartum psychosis) እንደነበረባት በመግለጽ ወንጀለኛ አይደለችም በማለት ይከራከራሉ። የ36 ዓመቷ የቀድሞ ነርስ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአእምሮ ህክምና ማዕከል ውስጥ የምትገኝ ሲሆን፣ አቃቤ ህግ እንደገና ክስ መመስረት ወይም በስምምነት መፍታት እንዳለበት ቀጣይ ስብሰባ ይወስናል።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa tokko mootummaa Massachusetts keessatti, Lindsay Clancy ijoollee ishii sadii ajjeesuun himatamtee turte irratti, gumii murtee kennu dadhabee tures dhimmi kun akka dhaabbatu murteessaniiru. Clancy ijoollee ishii ajjeesuu ishii kan amantus, abukaattoonni ishii yeroo sana rakkoo sammuu da'umsa booda dhufuun miidhamtee waan turteef itti gaafatamtuu miti jedhanii falmatu. Ganna 36 kan taate kun ammas bakka yaala sammuutti kan argamtu yoo ta'u, abbaan alangaa irra deebii murtii kennuu ykn mariidhaan furachuu isaanii gabaasa gara fuulduraatiin kan murtaa'u ta'a.

title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
english: Germany is facing a significant political shift as the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party aims to win a regional election in Saxony-Anhalt. If successful, this would be the first time a far-right group holds state-level power in Germany since the post-war era. Supporters are drawn to the party due to frustrations over immigration, the economy, and the perceived failures of mainstream political leadership.
amharic: ጀርመን በሳክሶኒ-አንሃልት ግዛት በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ታያለች ተብሎ ይጠበቃል፣ ይህም የቀኝ ዘመም አራማጁ የአማራጭ ለጀርመን (AfD) ፓርቲ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በክልል ደረጃ ስልጣን ለመያዝ እየተንቀሳቀሰ ነው። ይህ ፓርቲ ድል ከተቀዳጀ፣ ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ በጀርመን የክልል ስልጣን የያዘ የመጀመሪያው የቀኝ ዘመም ፓርቲ ይሆናል። የፓርቲው ደጋፊዎች በኢሚግሬሽን፣ በኢኮኖሚ ችግሮች እና በነባር ፓርቲዎች መበሳጨታቸው ለዚህ ድጋፍ ዋነኛ ምክንያቶች ተደርገው ይወሰዳሉ።
oromo: Jarmanin filannoo naannoo Saxony-Anhalt irratti jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa kan qunnamtu ta'uun ishee dubbatamaa jira; kunis paartiin mirga-qaxxaamuraa Alternative for Germany (AfD) jedhamu sadarkaa naannootti aangoo argachuuf carraaqaa waan jiruufi. Yoo paartiin kun injifate, erga waraana addunyaa lammaffaa booda paartiin mirga-qaxxaamuraa tokko naannoo tokko bulchuun seenaa keessatti kan jalqabaati. Deeggartoonni paartichaa rakkoolee godaantotaa, diinagdee fi dadhabina paartilee siyaasaa durii mudateen kan irraan kan ka'e jijjiirama barbaadaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump says US may target Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain ‘very soon’
english: US President Donald Trump has reiterated his threat to potentially strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain in the near future. In response, Iran's air defense leadership stated that the nation remains fully prepared to handle any military confrontation. Officials in Tehran emphasized that they view these ongoing threats as serious and remain vigilant.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ የኢራኑን 'ፒካክስ' ተራራ ኢላማ ሊያደርጉ እንደሚችሉ እንደገና ዝተዋል። ለዚህ ምላሽ የኢራን የአየር መከላከያ አዛዥ ሀገሪቱ ለማንኛውም ወታደራዊ ግጭት ዝግጁ እንደሆነች ገልጸዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ስጋቱ አሁንም ስላለ ከፍተኛ ጥንቃቄ እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantii Ameerikaa Doolaard Tiraamp gargaarsa ykn weerara gaara 'Pikkaaks' kan Iraan irratti gaggeessuuf sodaachisuu isaanii irra deebhanii dubbataniiru. Iraan gama isheetiin, ajajaan ittisa qilleensaa biyyattii akka ibsanitti, isaan weerara kamiyyuu akkaataa barbaachiseef qophii akka ta'an ibsaniiru. Hoji geggeessitoonni Iraan balaan ammayyuu waan hin dabarreef qophiin isaanii itti fufuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: ‘Small potatoes’: US President Trump downplays war on Iran
english: President Donald Trump has described the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran as a minor military issue, dismissing its significance despite the loss of 18 American service members and rising energy costs. Both Trump and Vice President JD Vance have strategically avoided labeling the situation as a formal war, instead characterizing it as intermittent strikes to bypass the need for congressional approval. Analysts suggest this specific language is part of an administration effort to minimize public concern and avoid constitutional requirements regarding war declarations.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለውን የአሜሪካ እና የእስራኤል ግጭት ምንም ያህል የ18 የአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ህይወት ቢቀጠፍና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ቢጨምርም እንደ ቀላል ጉዳይ ገልጸውታል። ትራምፕ እና ምክትላቸው ጄዲ ቫንስ ግጭቱን በይፋ ጦርነት ብለው ከመጥራት ይልቅ የሕግ አውጭውን አካል ፈቃድ ላለመጠየቅ ሲባል እንደ የተወሰኑ ጥቃቶች አድርገው ለማቅረብ እየሞከሩ ነው። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ከሆነ ይህ አገላለጽ አስተዳደሩ የህዝብን ትኩረት ለመቀነስ እና ከጦርነት አዋጅ ጋር የተያያዙ ሕገ-መንግስታዊ ግዴታዎችን ለማምለጥ የሚጠቀምበት ስልት ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaant Doonaald Traamp, waraanni Ameerikaa fi Israa’el garaa garaa Iran irratti gaggeessaa jiran kun lubbuun loltoota Ameerikaa 18 darbee fi gatiin boba'aa dabalee osoo jiruu, akka waan salphaatti ilaaluun dubbataniiru. Traampis ta'e itti-aanaan isaanii Jeedi Vaans, rakkoo kana 'waraana' jedhanii waamuun irraa of qusachuun, hayyama paarlaamaa fudhachuu irraa bilisa bahuuf jecha 'duula xiqqoo' jedhanii gadi qabanii ibsaniiru. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, jecha akkanaa fayyadamuun isaanii mootummaan kun guddina rakkoo kanaa dhoksuuf fi seera bu'uuraa waraana labsuu wajjin walqabatu jalaa miliiquuf mala fayyadamaa jiranu dha.

title: Tunisia arrests journalist Mohamed Yousfi amid crackdown on critics
english: Tunisian authorities have arrested prominent journalist and editor Mohamed Yousfi, marking the latest move in a ongoing government campaign against media figures and political critics. This detention follows several recent convictions and prison sentences handed down to other journalists and activists under the administration of President Kais Saied. Human rights organizations are expressing deep concern, arguing that these actions reflect a broader effort to suppress independent voices and undermine the nation's judicial independence.
amharic: የቱኒዚያ ባለስልጣናት ታዋቂውን ጋዜጠኛ መሐመድ ዩሱፍን በቁጥጥር ስር ያዋሉት ሲሆን ይህም በፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሳይድ አስተዳደር ስር በሚዲያ ባለሙያዎች እና በተቺዎች ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለው የዘመቻ አካል ነው። ይህ እስር በሌሎች ጋዜጠኞች እና አክቲቪስቶች ላይ በተላለፉ ተከታታይ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔዎች የተከተለ ነው። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ነጻ አስተያየቶችን ለማፈን እና የፍትህ ስርአቱን ነጻነት ለመሸርሸር የሚደረግ ጥረት መሆኑን በመግለጽ ስጋታቸውን እየገለጹ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Tunisiyaa gabaasaa fi qophiin beekamaa Mohaamed Yuusfii hidhuun, mootummaan pirezidaant Kaayiis Saayid mormitootaa fi miidiyaaleerratti tarkaanfii fudhachaa jiru kan itti fufsiise ta’u agarsiisa. Hidhaan kun, kanaan dura gabaasotii fi qabsaa’ota biroo irratti murtiiwwan adabbii darbaa turan kan hordofee dha. Dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa tarkaanfiiwwan kun sagalee bilisaa ukkaamsuu fi walaba ta’uu sirna seeraa biyyattii miidhuuf kan karoorfaman ta’uu ibsuun mormaa jiru.

title: Mock Republican convention website tops Google, redirects to Epstein files
english: A fake website pretending to be the official page for the 2026 Republican convention appeared at the top of Google search results. Instead of providing event details, the site redirected visitors to government documents regarding Jeffrey Epstein. Republican officials have condemned the prank as misinformation, while Democratic politicians are using the incident to highlight ongoing controversies surrounding the Trump administration's handling of the Epstein files.
amharic: ለ2026 የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ጉባኤ ኦፊሴላዊ ድረ-ገጽ መስሎ የቀረበ የሀሰት ድረ-ገጽ በጎግል የፍለጋ ውጤቶች ላይ ቀዳሚ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል። ድረ-ገጹ ስለ ዝግጅቱ መረጃ ከመስጠት ይልቅ ተጠቃሚዎችን ወደ ጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን መዝገቦች ቀጥተኛ አገናኝ ይወስዳል። የሪፐብሊካን ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱን ሀሰተኛ መረጃ ሲሉ ሲያወግዙት፣ የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ አባላት ግን ይህንን አጋጣሚ በመጠቀም የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከኤፕስታይን መዝገቦች ጋር በተያያዘ የፈጠረውን ውዝግብ እያነሱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Websayitiin sobaa kan walgahii paartii Rippabilikaanii bara 2026 fakkaatee dhihaate, bu'aa barbaaddee Google irratti sadarkaa duraa qabate ture. Websayitichi odeeffannoo walgahichaa kennuu mannaa, namoota fayyadaman gara galmee seenaa Jeefrii Episteeyinitti geessaa ture. Hoggantoonni Rippabilikaanii gocha kana 'oduu sobaa' jechuun balaaleffatan, gama biraatiin ammoo miseensonni Paartii Dimokiraataas haala bulchiinsi Traamp galmee Episteeyin qabate irratti guungummii uumame kaasuuf carraa kana itti fayyadamaa jiru.

title: Tunisia police arrest journalist Mohamed Yousfi, critic of Kais Saied
english: Tunisian police have detained journalist Mohamed Yousfi, a well-known critic of President Kais Saied, while he was arriving for a radio interview. While authorities have not officially stated the reason for his arrest, rights groups view this as part of an ongoing trend to suppress independent journalism in the country. Several other media professionals have also faced legal action or imprisonment since the President began ruling by decree in 2021.
amharic: የቱኒዚያ ፖሊስ ለፕሬዝዳንት ካይስ ሰኢድ ጠንካራ ተቺ የሆኑትን ጋዜጠኛ መሐመድ ዩሱፍን በሬዲዮ ፕሮግራም ላይ ለመሳተፍ ሲሄዱ በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏቸዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ለእስሩ ግልጽ ምክንያት ባይሰጡም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖች ይህ ድርጊት በሀገሪቱ ነጻ ጋዜጠኝነትን ለማፈን የሚደረግ ጥረት አካል እንደሆነ ይገልጻሉ። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ከ2021 ጀምሮ በአዋጅ መግዛት ከጀመሩ ወዲህ በርካታ ጋዜጠኞች እና የሚዲያ ባለሙያዎች ተመሳሳይ እስራትና ክስ እንደተፈረደባቸው ይታወቃል።
oromo: Poolisiin Tunisiyaa gaazexeessaa fi qeeqa cimaa pireezidaant Kaayis Saayid ta'an Mohaammad Yuusif, sagantaa raadiyoorratti hirmaachuuf yommuu deeman qabanii hidhaniiru. Mootummaan sababa hidhaa kanaa ifatti kan hin ibsin yoo ta'u, gareewwan mirga namoomaa gochi kun miidiyaa walaba ta'e biyyattii keessaa cunqursuuf kan godhamaa jiruudha jedhaniiru. Pireezidaantichi bara 2021 irraa eegalanii aangoo guutuu qabatanii erga bulchuu eegalanii booda, gaazexeessitoonni fi ogeeyyiin miidiyaa hedduun hidhaa fi himannaa adda addaa keessa turaniiru.

title: Kpler says Hormuz traffic dropped sharply on 31 August, Bab el-Mandeb stable
english: Maritime data firm Kpler reported that ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz dropped by 50% on August 31, with only five confirmed crossings compared to ten the previous day. In contrast, activity in the Bab el-Mandeb remained steady, with 35 vessels passing through the area without any reported incidents. Officials noted that the Hormuz data is still preliminary and may be updated as more information about unrecorded vessels becomes available.
amharic: የባህር ትራንስፖርት መረጃ ኩባንያ ክፕለር (Kpler) እንዳስታወቀው ኦገስት 31 ቀን በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል የሚያልፉ መርከቦች ቁጥር በ50 በመቶ ቀንሷል። ቀደም ሲል አስር መርከቦች ያልፉበት በነበረው መስመር በዚያ ዕለት የተመዘገቡት አምስት መርከቦች ብቻ ናቸው። በሌላ በኩል በባብ ኤል-ማንዴብ በኩል ያለው እንቅስቃሴ የተረጋጋ ሆኖ የቀጠለ ሲሆን 35 መርከቦች ያለምንም ችግር አልፈዋል። የሆርሙዝ መረጃ ጊዜያዊ መሆኑን እና ወደፊት ተጨማሪ መረጃዎች ሲገኙ ቁጥሩ ሊቀየር እንደሚችል ኩባንያው ገልጿል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni odeeffannoo bishaanii Kpler akka gabaaseetti, lakkoofsi markaa qaxxaamura Hormuz gidduu galeessa gaafa Hagayya 31 irraa kaasee dhibbeentaa 50n hir'ateera. Guyyaa sana markawwan shan qofatu qaxxaamure; kunis guyyaa durii irraa yoo ilaalamu hir'ina guddaadha. Gama biraatiin, sochii Bab el-Mandeb irratti ta'e tasgabbaa’aa kan ture yoo ta'u, markawwan 35 rakkoo tokko malee qaxxaamuraniiru. Odeeffannoon Hormuz kun ammaaf kan jalqabaa waan ta'eef, odeeffannoon dabalataa yoo argame lakkoofsi isaa jijjiiramuu akka danda'u ibsameera.

title: US okays $5.75 billion munitions, engines sale to Saudi Arabia
english: The United States government has authorized a major $5.75 billion arms deal with Saudi Arabia, including precision-guided munitions from Boeing and advanced engines from Honeywell. This agreement aims to bolster the kingdom's defensive capabilities against regional threats while deepening military cooperation with American forces. Officials stated that the sale supports national security interests by strengthening the defense of a key regional partner.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ከሳውዲ አረቢያ ጋር የ5.75 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የጦር መሳሪያ ሽያጭ ስምምነት አጽድቋል። ስምምነቱ ቦይንግ የሚያመርታቸውን ዘመናዊ ሚሳኤሎች እና የሃኒዌል የሞተር መለዋወጫዎችን ያካተተ ነው። ይህ ግዢ የሳውዲን የመከላከል አቅም በማጠናከር ከአሜሪካ ጋር ያላትን ወታደራዊ ትብብር እንደሚያሳድግ ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa Sa'udii Arabiyaatti meeshaalee waraanaa fi injiniiwwan gurguruuf waliigaltee doolaara biliyoona 5.75 ta'u raggaasiseera. Waliigalteen kun meeshaalee gurguddaa Booyingii fi injiniiwwan Haniwell kan of keessatti qabatu yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaa humna ittisa biyyaalessaa Sa'udii cimsuufi. Mootummaan Ameerikaa akka jedhetti, gurgurtaan kun nageenya naannichaa eeguufi tumsa waraanaa biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru caalaatti cimsachuuf gargaara.

title: Iran vows ‘pre-emptive operations’ against perceived threats
english: A senior Iranian military official announced that the country is shifting its defense strategy to include pre-emptive strikes against any potential threats. Brigadier-General Mohammad Akrami Nia explained that these measures are intended to deter enemies by acting before they can strike. This change in military doctrine signals a more aggressive approach to national security.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣን ሀገሪቱ በየትኛውም ስጋት ላይ ቅድመ ጥቃት የሚሰነዝር አዲስ የመከላከያ ስትራቴጂ መከተሏን አስታውቀዋል። ብርጋዴር ጀነራል መሀመድ አክራሚ ኒያ እንደገለጹት፣ ይህ እርምጃ ጠላቶችን ለመከላከል እና ጥቃት ከመሰንዘራቸው በፊት ለመመከት ያለመ ነው። ይህ ወታደራዊ አቋም ለሀገራዊ ደህንነት የበለጠ ጠንካራ አቀራረብን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan akka jedhanitti, biyyattiin miidhaa kamiyyuu dura dhaabbachuuf tarkaanfii duraa fudhachuuf karoora qabdi. Birgaadiyar Jeneraal Mohaammad Akraamii Niyaa akka ibsanitti, jijjiiramni kun diinonni utuu hin haleelin dura of ittisuuf kan gargaaru dha. Jijjiiramni tooftaa waraanaa kunis eegumsa biyyattii irratti fedhii cimaa akka qaban agarsiisa.

title: Israeli police kill Palestinian in Jerusalem as army blocks aid for Qusra
english: Israeli police shot and killed a 33-year-old Palestinian man in Jerusalem after alleging he attempted a stabbing attack. Simultaneously, the Israeli military blocked a group of activists from delivering essential food and medical supplies to a Palestinian village that has been under siege by settlers for nearly a month. These events occurred alongside a broader wave of military raids and settler attacks across the occupied West Bank.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፖሊስ በኢየሩሳሌም የ33 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ ወጣት ቢላዋ ሊያጠቃ ሞክሯል በሚል ተኩሶ ገድሎታል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች ለወራት ታግዶ በቆየው የፍልስጤም መንደር ውስጥ አስፈላጊ የሆኑ ምግብ እና መድሃኒቶችን ለማድረስ የሞከሩ አክቲቪስቶችን ከልክለዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ውስጥ ከተካሄዱ ተከታታይ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻዎች እና የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት ጋር በተያያዘ የተከሰቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Poolisiin Israa'el nama Falasxiimii umrii 33 ta'e tokko magaalaa Yerusaalemitti waraansa hidhatee dhufeera jechuun dhukaasaa ajjeesaniiru. Yeroo wal fakkaataatti, waraanni Israa'el ganda Falasxiimii kan ji'a tokko guutuu jiraattotni ishee qe'ee isaanii keessatti cufamanii turanitti gargaarsa nyaataa fi qorichaa geessuuf kan yaalan namoota nagaa akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru. Gochootni kun, naannoo Qilleensa dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara waraanaa fi haleellaa godaantotaan raawwatamaa jiru waliin wal qabatu.

title: Costa Rican president signals openness to domestic US military operations
english: Costa Rican President Laura Fernandez has expressed interest in collaborating with the United States military to combat transnational crime, drug trafficking, and terrorism. She clarified that no specific plans are currently underway and stressed that any foreign military involvement would require formal approval from the national legislature. This stance reflects her commitment to addressing the country's rising homicide rates without resorting to the long-term states of emergency used by other regional leaders.
amharic: የኮስታ ሪካዋ ፕሬዚዳንት ላውራ ፈርናንዴዝ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ያለውን የድንበር ተሻጋሪ ወንጀል፣ የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር እና ሽብርተኝነትን ለመዋጋት ከአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ጋር ለመስራት ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ገልጸዋል። ሆኖም ምንም አይነት የተጠናቀቀ ዕቅድ እንደሌለና ማንኛውም የውጭ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ የአገሪቱ ፓርላማ ይሁንታ እንደሚያስፈልገው አብራርተዋል። ይህ አቋም ፕሬዚዳንቷ በአገሪቱ እያደገ የመጣውን የፀጥታ ችግር በሌሎች የአካባቢው አገራት እንደሚታየው የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ ሳይታወጅ ለመፍታት ያላቸውን ዝግጁነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Kostaarikaa Laura Farnaandeez, yakka daangaa ce'uu, gurgurtaan mukhaalaa fi shororkeessummaa ittisuuf waraana Yuunaayitid Isteetsii wajjin hojjechuuf fedhii qaban ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, hanga ammaatti karoori hojiitti hiikame akka hin jirre fi waraanni alaa kamiyyuu biyyattii keessatti socho'uuf hayyama mana maree biyyoolessaa akka barbaadu hubachiisaniiru. Dhimmi kun, pireezidaantittiin rakkoo nageenyaa biyyattii keessatti dabalaa jiru, akka biyyoota ollaa birootti labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa malee furuuf karoorfachuu isaanii kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Betis beat Real Madrid as Mbappe misses penalty in first La Liga defeat
english: Real Betis handed Real Madrid their first La Liga defeat of the season with a 1-0 victory, ending Jose Mourinho's perfect start. Troy Parrott scored the decisive late goal for Betis, while goalkeeper Alvaro Valles secured the win by saving a stoppage-time penalty from Kylian Mbappe. Despite several attempts, Madrid were unable to break through the Betis defense, resulting in a surprising setback for the club.
amharic: ሪያል ቤቲስ ሪያል ማድሪድን 1 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ የዘንድሮውን የላሊጋ የውድድር ዘመን የመጀመሪያ ሽንፈት እንዲቀምስ አድርጓል። የጆዜ ሞሪንሆ ቡድን ከዚህ ቀደም የነበረውን አሸናፊነት ጉዞ የገታው የትሮይ ፓሮት ብቸኛ ግብ ነው። በጨዋታው መገባደጃ ላይ ኪሊያን ምባፔ የተሰጠውን የፍጹም ቅጣት ምት ግብ ጠባቂው አልቫሮ ቫሌስ በማዳኑ ሪያል ቤቲስ ድሉን ለማረጋገጥ ችሏል።
oromo: Ri'aal Betis tapha La Liga irratti Ri'aal Maadriid 1-0 injifachuun, jalqaba gaarii Jose Mourinho maasiif ture dhaabseera. Galchiin inni injifannoo Ri'aal Betisif argamsiise Troy Parrottin kan lakkoofsiisame yoo ta'u, goolkiin Alvaro Valles immoo yeroo dabalataatti kaasee goolii adabbii Kylian Mbappe dhaabuun injifannoo isaanii mirkaneesseera. Ri'aal Maadriid carraa hedduu qabaatus, ittisa Ri'aal Betis darbuu dadhabuun injifatamuu danda'eera.

title: US regulator opens safety investigation as Tesla launches driverless taxis
english: The U.S. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has launched a formal investigation into Tesla's new autonomous Cybercab service. This probe aims to determine if the driverless vehicles comply with national safety regulations. The review follows the recent debut of the service in Austin, Texas.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የሀይዌይ ትራፊክ ደህንነት አስተዳደር በቴስላ አዲሱ የራስ ገዝ የሳይበርካብ አገልግሎት ላይ መደበኛ ምርመራ መጀመሩን አስታውቋል። ይህ ምርመራ ያለ ሹፌር የሚንቀሳቀሱት ተሽከርካሪዎች የሀገሪቱን የደህንነት መስፈርቶች የሚያሟሉ መሆናቸውን ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው። ጉዳዩ የተነሳው አገልግሎቱ በቴክሳስ ኦስቲን ከተማ በቅርቡ ከተጀመረ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Nageenyaa Karaa Gurguddaa Ameerikaa tajaajila konkolaataa ofiin oofuu kan Tesla 'Cybercab' jedhamu irratti qorannoo jalqabeera. Qorannoon kun konkolaatonni nama malee adeeman kunneen seera nageenyaa biyyattii kan guutan ta'uu isaanii mirkaneessuuf kan gaggeeffamu dha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan dhufe tajaajilli kun magaalaa Austin, Texas keessatti erga eegalamee booda.

title: Witkoff and Kushner will travel to ‘end’ Russia’s war in Ukraine: Trump
english: President Donald Trump has dispatched Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff to Russia and Ukraine to attempt to restart peace negotiations. The envoys are expected to present a new peace proposal this weekend despite ongoing intense military conflict between the two nations. Trump believes personal animosity between the leaders of Russia and Ukraine has been a major obstacle to finding a diplomatic resolution.

oromo: Pirezidaanti Doolaald Tiraamp, marii nagaa Ruusiyaafi Yuukreen gidduutti dhaabbate deebisanii jalqabsiisuuf Jaared Kushinerifi Istiiv Witkoof gara biyyoota lameenitti erganiiru. Bakka bu'oonni kun waraanni cimaan gidduu isaanii jiru iyyuu, dhuma torban kanaatti yaada nagaa haaraa dhiyeessuuf ni eegamu. Tiraamp, jibbi dhuunfaa hogganoota Ruusiyaafi Yuukreen gidduu jiru furmaata diippiloomaasii argachuurratti gufuu guddaa ta'uu himaniiru.

title: Death toll from Israeli attacks on Lebanon rises to three
english: Israeli military drone strikes in southern and eastern Lebanon have resulted in the deaths of at least three individuals. The attacks targeted five distinct locations across the Tyre, Nabatieh, and Beqaa regions. Additionally, health officials reported that 23 people sustained injuries during these operations.
amharic: በደቡባዊ እና ምስራቃዊ ሊባኖስ በእስራኤል የድሮን ጥቃቶች ቢያንስ ሶስት ሰዎች መሞታቸውን የሀገሪቱ የጤና ሚኒስቴር አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱ በታይር፣ በናባቲዬህ እና በቤቃ ክልሎች በሚገኙ አምስት የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ነበር። በዚሁ ጥቃት ተጨማሪ 23 ሰዎች የአካል ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el Kibba fi Baha Libaanoositti ergaa roga-malee (drone) fayyadamuun miidhaa geessiseen namoonni yoo xiqqaate saddeeti du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun naannolee Tyre, Nabatieh fi Beqaa keessatti bakkeewwan shanirratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, namoonni 23 immoo miidhaniiru.

title: Jewish groups back stronger measures on Israel in letter to Andy Burnham
english: Several Jewish civil society organizations have sent a letter to Prime Minister Andy Burnham demanding stricter policies against Israel and the protection of pro-Palestine protest rights. This push follows reports that the government is considering banning products from illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank. Meanwhile, some prominent British Jewish leaders and the Chief Rabbi are actively opposing these potential sanctions, arguing that such actions could harm the community.
amharic: በርካታ የአይሁድ ሲቪል ማህበረሰብ ቡድኖች በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ በርንሃም ላይ ጫና በመፍጠር በእስራኤል ላይ ጠንካራ እርምጃዎችን እንዲወስዱ እና የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ ሰልፎችን እንዳይከለከሉ በደብዳቤ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ የተከሰተው መንግስት ከዌስት ባንክ ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ የሚመጡ ምርቶችን ለመከልከል እያሰበ ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ሆኖም አንዳንድ ዋና ዋና የአይሁድ ድርጅቶች እና ዋናው ረቢ እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች በአይሁድ ማህበረሰብ ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ይኖራቸዋል በሚል እርምጃዎቹን በመቃወም ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Gareewwan hawaasa Yihuudii hedduun, Ministira Muummee Andy Burnham biratti gidirsuudhaan Israa’el irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatuu fi mirga hiriira deggarsa Falasxiin kabajchiisuuf xalayaa barreessaniiru. Kun kan ta'e mootummaan Israa’el naannoo Qarxii dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti bakka buufata seeraan alaa irraa oomishaalee dhorkuuf qophiirra jiruun wal qabatee dha. Ta'us, hogganoonni Yihuudii biyyattii fi Rabbiin guddaan tarkaanfiin kun hawaasa Yihuudii irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisa jedhanii mormaa jiru.

title: Trump says Iran war is 'small potatoes' for US
english: Donald Trump has downplayed the ongoing military tension between the United States and Iran, labeling the conflict as minor. His administration is attempting to minimize the significance of these hostilities as the midterm elections approach. Trump reinforced this perspective by describing the situation as a limited military engagement rather than a major war.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል እየተካሄደ ያለውን ወታደራዊ ግጭት አሳንሰው በመመልከት፣ ጉዳዩ ትልቅ እንደማይባል ገልጸዋል። የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከመካከለኛ ጊዜ ምርጫ በፊት የዚህን ግጭት ክብደት ለመቀነስ እየሞከረ ይገኛል። ትራምፕ ሁኔታውን እንደ ትልቅ ጦርነት ሳይሆን እንደ ተራ ወታደራዊ ግጭት በመቁጠር ጉዳዩን ከልክ በላይ እንዳይጋነን አድርገዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa kan Ameerikaafi Iraan gidduutti uumame baay'ee xiqqaadha jechuun xiqqeessanii ibsaniiru. Bulchiinsi isaanii filannoo dhufu dura dhimma kana akka waan cimaa tokkotti akka hin fudhatamneef carraaqqii gochaa jiru. Trump haala kana akka waraana guddaatti osoo hin taane, akka walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa kan salphaatti ilaalamu tokkotti ibsuuf yaalaniiru.

title: Why did Trump meet members of an anti-Zionist Orthodox Jewish group?
english: President Donald Trump recently hosted a delegation of Haredi Jewish leaders at the White House to mark the upcoming Rosh Hashanah holiday. The group included Rabbi Aaron Teitelbaum, a prominent figure known for his anti-Zionist views within the Satmar community. This meeting, which also involved Vice President JD Vance, drew attention due to the presence of these religious figures who typically oppose the existence of the Zionist state.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሮሽ ሃሻና በዓልን ምክንያት በማድረግ የሃሬዲ አይሁዳዊ መሪዎችን በዋይት ሀውስ ተቀብለው አነጋገሩ። በልዑካን ቡድኑ ውስጥ በሳትማር ማህበረሰብ ዘንድ የሚታወቁትና በፀረ-ጽዮናዊ አቋማቸው የሚታወቁት ረቢ አሮን ቴይቴልባም ይገኙበታል። ከምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ጋር በተካሄደው በዚህ ስብሰባ ላይ የተገኙት እነዚህ ሃይማኖታዊ መሪዎች፣ የጽዮናዊነትን ሀሳብ የሚቃወሙ በመሆናቸው በብዙዎች ዘንድ ትኩረት ስቧል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doonald Tiraamp ayyaana Roosh Haashaanaa sababeeffachuun hoggantoota amantii Yihuudotaa kanneen 'Haredi' jedhaman Waayitii Haawusitti simatanii mari'achiisaniiru. Garee kana keessa, hawaasa Saatmaar keessatti kan beekaman fi yaada 'anti-Zionist' ykn mormitoota Ziwoonizimii kan ta'an Rabbi Aaron Teitelbaum argamu. Mariin kun fiixee hoggantoota amantii mootummaa Ziwoonizimii mormanii fi Muummicha Pireezidaantii J.D. Vaanis gidduutti taasifame kun xiyyeeffannoo hedduu argateera.

title: Israeli drones drop bombs on southern Lebanon’s Mansouri
english: Israeli military drones carried out an attack on the town of Mansouri in southern Lebanon. The operation involved dropping explosives, which resulted in multiple blasts across the area. This event is part of the ongoing hostilities occurring along the border region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ድሮኖች በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ በምትገኘው ማንሱሪ ከተማ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ድሮኖቹ ፈንጂዎችን በመጣል በስፍራው ተከታታይ ፍንዳታዎች እንዲከሰቱ አድርገዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በድንበር አካባቢ እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት አንዱ አካል ነው።
oromo: Xiyyaaroonni malee namoota (drone) kan waraana Israa'el magaalaa Mansuurii kan kibba Libaanositti argamtu irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaa kanaanis boombiiwwan gadi darbamuun bakka sanaatti dhuka’iinsi hedduun dhaga’ameera. Tarkaanfiin kunis walitti bu’iinsa daangaa sana irratti taasifamaa jiru keessaa tokko dha.

title: Israeli strike kills two in southern Lebanon amid ongoing escalation
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting a motorcycle in Kfar Reman killed two people as military operations intensify across southern Lebanon. Despite multiple U.S.-brokered truce agreements, Israeli forces continue to conduct heavy raids and artillery strikes against several towns in the region. These ongoing hostilities have resulted in significant casualties and widespread displacement since the latest escalation began earlier this year.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በከፋ ሬማን ከተማ በአንድ ሞተር ሳይክል ላይ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተገልጿል። በአሜሪካ አሸማጋይነት የተደረጉ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች ቢኖሩም፣ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በበርካታ የክልሉ ከተሞች ላይ ድብደባ እና የአየር ጥቃታቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል። ይህ ቀውስ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ ከፍተኛ የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና በርካታ ነዋሪዎች ከቀያቸው መፈናቀላቸው ይታወቃል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaalaa Kfar Remanitti bakka kutaatti namoota lama ajjeeseera. Waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa mootummaan Ameerikaa giddu galeessummaan irra ga'e darbuun, Israa'el naannolee kibba Libaanoositti haleellaa ishee jabeessitee itti fufteetti. Kanneen keessa haleellaa kanaan namoonni hedduun du'anii, namoonni miliyoona tokkoo ol ta'an immoo manaa fi qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru.

title: Andrew Tate indicted in Romania for trafficking minors, money laundering
english: Romanian prosecutors have formally indicted influencer Andrew Tate and his brother Tristan on serious charges including child trafficking, sexual exploitation, and money laundering. Authorities allege the brothers deceived victims into romantic relationships before forcing them to perform in sexually explicit online content through intimidation and violence. While the Tates maintain their innocence and plan to contest the claims, they are currently detained in the United States awaiting potential extradition to the UK for separate sexual assault allegations.
amharic: የሮማኒያ አቃቤ ህግ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪው አንድሪው ታይት እና ወንድሙ ትሪስታን ላይ ህጻናትን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ማዘዋወር፣ የፆታ ብዝበዛ እና ህገ-ወጥ የገንዘብ ዝውውር ክስ መስርተዋል። ወንድማማቾቹ ሰለባዎቻቸውን በፍቅር ስሜት በማታለል በጉልበት እና በማስፈራራት በኢንተርኔት ላይ የብልግና ምስሎችን እንዲሰሩ ያስገደዷቸው እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ታይት እና ወንድሙ ክሱን በሙሉ ውድቅ ያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ በእስር ላይ ሆነው ወደ ብሪታኒያ ለሚቀርብባቸው ሌላ የፆታ ጥቃት ክስ የውጭ ሀገር አሳልፎ የመስጠት ሂደትን በመጠባበቅ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Abbaan alangaa Roomaaniyaa, beekamtii guddaa qabu kan jedhame Andrew Tate fi obboleessi isaa Tristan irratti yakka ijoollee gurgurachuu, gudeeddii fi qarshii seeraan alaa daddabarsuu jedhuun himata bananiiru. Obboloonni kunneen miidhamtoota jaalalaan gowwoomsuudhaan dirqisiisuu fi doorsisuudhaan marsariitii irratti viidiyoo qaama saalaa agarsiisu akka hojjetan dirqisiisaa turuu himatamaaniiru. Obboloonni Tate himata kana hunda kan haalan yoo ta'u, amma yeroof Yuunaayitid Isteetis keessatti hidhamanii, himata gudeeddii biroo biyya Biriteen keessatti irratti banamee jiruun gara biyyattii erguuf qophiirra jiru.

title: UN votes to adopt new world map that reflects Africa’s true size
english: The United Nations General Assembly has approved a new world map that correctly displays the true size of Africa, ending centuries of distortion caused by the outdated Mercator projection. Spearheaded by the African Union, this move seeks to correct the colonial-era bias that made Western nations appear larger than they actually are. While the new map is not legally binding, advocates hope it will lead to more accurate representations of the continent in schools, media, and digital platforms globally.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ጠቅላላ ጉባኤ የአፍሪካን ትክክለኛ መጠን የሚያሳይ አዲስ የዓለም ካርታን በይፋ አጽድቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የቆየውን የሜርካተር ካርታ አጠቃቀም በመቀየር ምዕራባውያን አገራትን ትልቅ አድርጎ የሚያሳየውን የቅኝ ግዛት ዘመን አድልዎ ለማስተካከል ያለመ ነው። ካርታው አስገዳጅ ባይሆንም፣ ትክክለኛውን የአህጉሪቱን ስፋት በትምህርት ቤቶች እና በሌሎች ሚዲያዎች ላይ እንዲንጸባረቅ ለማድረግ ትልቅ እርምጃ ተወስዷል።
oromo: Waltajjin Waliigalaa Tokkummaa Mootummootaa kaartaa addunyaa haaraa kan sadarkaa dhugaa Afrikaa sirriitti agarsiisu raggaasiseera. Murtoon kun kaartaa 'Mercator' kan durii fayyadamuurraan kan ka'e biyyoota dhihaa guddisee mul'isuufi jijjiirama yeroo kolonii irraa dhufe sirreessuuf yaadamee kan dhihaate dha. Kaartichi dirqama seeraa kan hin qabne ta'us, qabsoo kana gaggeessitoonni kaarticha manneen barnootaa fi miidiyaalee addunyaa irratti akka sirriitti fayyadaman abdii qabu.
