title: Red Cross says four people released by Israel to Lebanon
english: The International Committee of the Red Cross helped return five Lebanese citizens home after they were released from Israeli custody. One person was sent back on Thursday, while the remaining four returned on Friday. This action follows reports that dozens of people have been held by Israel during the ongoing conflict with Hezbollah.
amharic: የቀይ መስቀል ዓለም አቀፍ ኮሚቴ በእስራኤል እስር ላይ የነበሩ አምስት የሊባኖስ ዜጎች ወደ ሀገራቸው እንዲመለሱ አድርጓል። አንድ ሰው ሐሙስ ቀን ሲለቀቅ የተቀሩት አራቱ ደግሞ አርብ ዕለት ወደ ቤታቸው ተመልሰዋል። ይህ የሆነው ከሂዝቦላህ ጋር በሚደረገው ጦርነት ምክንያት እስራኤል በርካታ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውላ በነበረችበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Hirmaannaa Qaxxaamura Diimaa idil-addunyaatiin lammiileen Liibaanoos shan kan turan hidhaa Israa'eel irraa gadhiifamanii gara biyya isaanii deebi'aniiru. Namni tokko Roobii, afran hafan immoo Jimaata gara biyyaatti deebi'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraana Hizboolaah wajjin jiru kanaan wal qabatee namoonni hedduun Israa'eelitti hidhamanii turuu hordofeeti.

title: Trump says US may hit Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain ‘soon’
english: President Donald Trump announced that the United States might launch an attack on Iran's Pickaxe Mountain in the near future. This location is a highly secured underground facility situated close to the Natanz uranium enrichment site. The area contains complex tunnel systems that are protected deep beneath the earth.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በቅርቡ በኢራን የሚገኘውን ‘ፒክአክስ ማውንቴን’ የተሰኘ ቦታ ጥቃት ልትሰነዝርበት እንደምትችል ተናግረዋል። ይህ ስፍራ በናታንዝ የዩራኒየም ማበልጸጊያ ማዕከል አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ እና ጥልቅ ዋሻዎችን የያዘ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ የተጠበቀ ቦታ ነው። ቦታው ከመሬት በታች በጥልቀት የተገነባ መሆኑ ይታወቃል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Yunaayitid Isteets dhiyeenyatti biyya Iraan keessatti gara gaara ‘Piikaaks Maawuntiin’ jedhamutti haleellaa raawwachuu dandeessi. Iddeen kun bakka uraniyeemii qulqulleessan kan Naataanz jedhamu biratti argamu yoo ta'u, godoo ykn holqa gadi fageenyaan qotame kan of keessaa qabuufi eegumsa cimaa kan godhameef dha.

title: US Congress passes bill punishing universities that boycott Israel
english: The US House of Representatives has approved legislation targeting universities that boycott Israel or block student exchange programs with the country. Schools receiving federal funding will be required to confirm they do not limit academic cooperation involving Israeli institutions or students. Failure to comply with these rules could lead to penalties regarding their federal financial aid eligibility.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት እስራኤልን የሚያገዱ ወይም ከእስራኤል ጋር የሚደረጉ የተማሪዎች ልውውጥ መርሃ ግብሮችን የሚከለክሉ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎችን የሚቀጣ ህግ አጽድቋል። የፌደራል መንግስት ድጋፍ የሚያገኙ የትምህርት ተቋማት በእስራኤል የትምህርት ፕሮግራሞች ላይ ምንም አይነት እገዳ እንደሌለባቸው በየአመቱ ማረጋገጥ ይጠበቅባቸዋል። ህጉን የሚያከብሩ ከሆነም በተቋማቱ የፌደራል የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ላይ እርምጃ ሊወሰድ ይችላል።
oromo: Mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Ameerikaa, yuunivarsiitiiwwan Israa'el lagatan ykn sagantaa jijjiirraa barattootaa Israa'el waliin ta'u danqan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu danda'u dambiin tokko raggaasiseera. Yuunivarsiitiin gargaarsa mootummaa federaalaa argatan kamiyyuu, sagantaalee Israa'el keessatti ykn Israa'elota waliin ta'u irratti daangaa akka hin jirre waggaa waggaan mirkaneeffachuu qabu. Dambii kana kan hin kabajne taanaan, gargaarsa maallaqaa federaalaa irraa akka dhorkaman gochuu danda'a.

title: US Congress passes bill punishing universities that boycott Israel
english: The U.S. House of Representatives has approved a bill that threatens to cut federal funding to universities that boycott Israel or restrict exchange programs with the country. Supporters argue the move is necessary to stop discrimination against Israeli institutions, while critics claim it is a political tactic used to silence dissent regarding the war in Gaza. The legislation, which saw some bipartisan support, now awaits a decision in the Senate to determine if it will become law.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት እስራኤልን የሚያገዱ ወይም ከእስራኤል ጋር የሚደረጉ የትምህርት ልውውጦችን የሚከለክሉ ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች የፌዴራል የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እንዲቋረጥባቸው የሚያደርግ ሕግ አጽድቋል። የሕጉ ደጋፊዎች ይህ እርምጃ በእስራኤል ተቋማት ላይ የሚደረገውን መድልዎ ለመግታት አስፈላጊ ነው ሲሉ፣ ተቃዋሚዎች ግን በጋዛ ጦርነት ዙሪያ የሚነሱ ትችቶችን ለማፈን የተዘጋጀ የፖለቲካ መሣሪያ ነው ብለዋል። በሁለቱም ወገኖች የተወሰነ ድጋፍ ያገኘው ይህ ሕግ ተግባራዊ ለመሆን የሴኔቱን ውሳኔ እየጠበቀ ነው።
oromo: Mana maree bakka buutota ummataa Ameerikaa kan Israa'eliin morman ykn jijjiirraa barnootaa Israa'el waliin ta'u dhorkatan yunivarsiitiiwwan irratti adabbii maallaqaa fi gargaarsa mootummaa dhabamsiisuu danda'u seeraan dabarseera. Deggertoonni seera kanaa tarkaanfiin kun gosa adda addaa irratti kan qiyyeefate (discrimination) dhaabuuf barbaachisaa dha jedhu; mormitoonni garuu seerni kun waraana Gaazaarratti yaada mormii dhageessisuu ukkaamsuuf kan oolu tarsiimoo siyaasaa ti jechuun morman. Seerni kun miseensota garee lamaanii irraas deggarsa kan argate yoo ta'u, amma gara seeneeti (Senate) ergameera.

title: Report: Israeli attacks kill eight Palestinians in past 24 hours
english: In the last 24 hours, Israeli military actions resulted in eight Palestinian deaths and dozens of injuries in Gaza. Health officials noted that rescue workers are currently unable to access many victims trapped under collapsed buildings or located in dangerous areas. Since the October 2025 ceasefire began, the total casualty count has reached over 1,300 deaths and 4,400 injuries.
amharic: ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ በእስራኤል ጥቃት ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያን ሲገደሉ በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። የጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው፣ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች በፍርስራሽ ስር እና በአደገኛ ቦታዎች ያሉ ሰዎችን መድረስ ተስኗቸዋል። ከጥቅምት 2025 የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ወዲህ በደረሰው ጥቃት የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ1,300 በላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti, haleellaa Israa'el raawwateen lammiileen Palastinuu saddeet ajjeefamanii hedduun madaa'aniiru. Ministeerri fayyaa akka ibsetti, gargaartoonni balaa iddoo inni kufe fi bakka balaa jiru dhaqqabuu dadhabuun isaanii ibsameera. Labsii dhaabbii waraana Adoolessa 2025 kaasee, namoonni 1,300 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu fi 4,400 ol ta'an madaa'uun beekameera.

title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
english: Two survivors were recently pulled from a tunnel in Nepal more than a week after devastating flash floods caused widespread destruction. While the disaster has claimed over 1,300 lives, these rescues have provided a much-needed sense of optimism for families searching for missing loved ones. Rescue teams are continuing their efforts to locate others trapped in the tunnel network, despite the significant obstacles posed by debris and mud.
amharic: ኔፓል ውስጥ ከባድ ጎርፍ ከደረሰ ከሳምንት በላይ በኋላ ሁለት ሰዎች በዋሻ ውስጥ በሕይወት ተገኝተዋል። አደጋው ከ1,300 በላይ ሰዎችን ሕይወት ቢቀጥፍም፣ የነዚህ ሰዎች መዳን ቤተሰቦቻቸው ለጠፉት ወገኖቻቸው ተስፋ ሰንቀዋል። የነፍስ አድን ሠራተኞች በጭቃ እና በድንጋይ በተሞላው ዋሻ ውስጥ የተቀሩትን ሰዎች ፍለጋቸውን አጠናክረው ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Nepaaliitti lolaa cimaa erga ga'ee torbaan tokkoo ol booda, namoonni lama holqa keessatti lubbuun argamaniiru. Balaan kun lubbuu namoota 1,300 ol galaafatus, fayyinni namoota kanaa maatiiwwan warra hafan barbaadaa jiraniif abdii kenneera. Gareewwan fayyisituu haala qilleensaafi cilee ykn biyyee baay'een guutame keessatti namoota hafan barbaaduuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jiru.

title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
english: A Russian drone strike directly targeted the office of Ukraine's security chief within the SBU headquarters in Kyiv. President Zelensky confirmed the attack and ordered a retaliatory response as the incident caused damage to the building and injured several people nearby. This escalation highlights growing Russian drone precision ahead of anticipated international diplomatic discussions.
amharic: የሩሲያ ሰው አልባ አውሮፕላን (ድሮን) በኪየቭ በሚገኘው የዩክሬን ደህንነት ቢሮ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤት ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ ጥቃቱን ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ በደረሰው ጉዳት እና ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሰዎች መኖራቸውን ተከትሎ ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንዲሰጥ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በቅርቡ ለሚጠበቀው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይት ዋዜማ ላይ የሩሲያ ጥቃት እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Xiyyaarri harkaan to'atamu kan Raashiyaa, magaalaa Kiyiv keessatti bakka bu'aa nageenyaa Yukreen irratti haleellaa raawwateera. Pireezidaanti Zelenskiin haleellaa kana mirkaneessanii, haleellichi miidhaa guddaa geessisuu fi namoota muraasa irratti miidhaa qaqqabsiisuu isaa hordofee, tarkaanfii deebii cimsuuf ajaja kennaniiru. Gochi kun marii dippiloomaasii gara fuulduraatti taasifamuuf deemu dura Raashiyaan haleellaa ishee hammaattee itti fufuun ishee mul'isa.

title: Indonesia wildfires send toxic haze across Southeast Asia
english: Widespread wildfires in Indonesia's Kalimantan province have destroyed over 200,000 hectares of land, causing severe ecological damage and endangering wildlife. The resulting toxic smoke has spread across Southeast Asia, leading to a significant decline in air quality for neighboring regions. Environmental organizations are now urging authorities to take responsibility for the crisis and address the environmental impact.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዥያ ካሊማንታን ግዛት እየተስፋፋ ያለው የእሳት አደጋ ከሁለት መቶ ሺህ ሄክታር በላይ መሬትን በማውደም በአካባቢው ለሚገኙ የዱር እንስሳት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል። ከእሳቱ የሚነሳው መርዛማ ጭስ ወደ ተለያዩ የደቡብ ምስራቅ እስያ ሀገራት በመዛመቱ የአየር ብክለትን እያባባሰ ይገኛል። የአካባቢ ጥበቃ ቡድኖች ለዚህ ጥፋት ተጠያቂነት እንዲኖር እና መፍትሄ እንዲሰጥበት ጥሪ እያቀረቡ ነው።
oromo: Itti fufiinsa ibidda bosonaa naannoo Kaalimantaan, Indoneeshiyaa keessatti mul'ateen lafti heektaara 200,000 ol ta'u barbadaa'ee jira. Ibidni kun lubbu-qabeeyyii bosonaa balaaf saaxilee kan jiru yoo ta'u, aara summii qabu gara biyyoota Kibba-Baha Eshiyaa biroo faca'ee qilleensa naannichaa xureessee jira. Gareeleen eegumsa naannoo balaa kanaaf itti gaafatamummaan akka fudhatamuufi tarkaanfiin hatattamaa akka fudhatamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Yemen’s army says recaptured key territory as clashes with Houthis continue
english: Yemeni government forces have reclaimed strategic hills in the Taiz region following intense two-day battles against Houthi rebels. The fighting, which spans the Red Sea coastline, has resulted in over 120 deaths on both sides, including government soldiers, rebels, and civilians caught in a ballistic missile strike. The Houthis are reportedly attempting to regain control of key areas overlooking the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and the port city of Mocha.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች ከሁቲ አማፂያን ጋር ላደረጉት የሁለት ቀን ከባድ ውጊያ ተከትሎ በታይዝ አካባቢ የሚገኙ ስልታዊ ኮረብታዎችን መልሰው መቆጣጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። በቀይ ባህር ዳርቻ በተካሄደው ግጭት በሁለቱም በኩል ከ120 በላይ ሰዎች ሲገደሉ፣ ከነዚህም መካከል ወታደሮች እና በባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት የተጎዱ ንፁሃን ዜጎች ይገኙበታል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር ወሽመጥን እና የሞቻ ወደብን ለመቆጣጠር በማለም ጥቃቱን እንዳደረሱ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Humnooti mootummaa Yaman haleellaa guyyoota lamaaf Hutiifota wajjin taasisaniin booda, naannoo Ta'izitti iddoo tarsiimawaa ta'an deeffachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa qarqara galaana diimaa irratti gaggeeffame kanaan lubbuun namoota 120 ol darbeera; isaan keessaas waraana mootummaa, finxaaleyyii fi namoota nagaa haleellaa misa'eelaan miidhaman kan dabalatuudha. Hutiifonnni kunniin daandii galaana Baab al-Maandeebii fi buufata doonii Mochaa to'achuuf akka carraaqaa jiran gabaasameera.

title: Rescuers race to save 10-year-old Algerian boy trapped in deep well
english: Emergency teams in Algeria are currently working to rescue a ten-year-old boy named Ayoub who has been trapped in a deep well for two days. The child fell into the 80-meter-deep shaft located in the El Ghassoul region. Rescuers are acting quickly as they attempt to reach the boy and bring him to safety.
amharic: በአልጄሪያ ኤል ጋሱል በተባለ አካባቢ የ10 ዓመቱ ህጻን አዩብ በ80 ሜትር ጥልቅ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ በመውደቁ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች እሱን ለማውጣት ከፍተኛ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ህጻኑ ጉድጓድ ውስጥ ከገባ ሁለት ቀናት ተቆጥረዋል። የነፍስ አድን ቡድኑ ህጻኑን በሰላም ለማውጣት ጊዜን በመሽቀዳደም ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Aljeeriyaatti mucaan waggaa 10 kan maqaan isaa Aayuub jedhamu boollaa gadi fageenya meetira 80 qabu keessatti kufuun guyyaa lamaaf achi keessatti qabamee jira. Gareen fayyistootaa mucicha lubbuun oolchuuf yeroo gabaabaa keessatti tattaaffii cimaa gochaa jiru. Tattaaffiin isa oolchuuf godhamu kun ammayyuu itti fufee jira.

title: US adds 162,000 jobs in August, raising Fed rate hike expectations
english: The United States added 162,000 jobs in August, significantly exceeding analyst expectations of roughly 55,000. Growth was largely driven by hiring in public education and the food service industry, while sectors like telecommunications and finance saw minor declines. This stronger-than-anticipated performance has prompted speculation that the Federal Reserve may increase interest rates at their upcoming meeting.
amharic: በነሐሴ ወር የአሜሪካ ኢኮኖሚ ከጠበቁት በላይ በሆነ ሁኔታ 162,000 አዳዲስ የስራ ዕድሎችን ፈጥሯል። ይህ እድገት በዋነኛነት በትምህርት ቤቶች እና በምግብ አገልግሎት ዘርፎች የተገኘ ሲሆን፣ አንዳንድ የቴክኖሎጂ እና የፋይናንስ ዘርፎች ግን መቀነስ አሳይተዋል። የተመዘገበው ጠንካራ የስራ እድገት የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ባንክ (ፌደራል ሪዘርቭ) በቅርቡ በሚያደርገው ስብሰባ የወለድ ምጣኔን ከፍ ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል ግምት አሳድሯል።
oromo: Ji'a Hagayyaa keessa, gabaan hojii Ameerikaa kutaalee barnootaa fi soorataa irratti hundaa'uun hojii haaraa 162,000 uumeera; kunis kan eegamee ture irra baay'ee caala. Hojiiwwan kun dabaluun isaanii, baankii giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (Federal Reserve) dhimmicha irratti mari'atee qooda qabeenyaa (interest rate) dabaluu danda'a jedhamee akka yaadamu godheera. Guddinni kun dinagdee biyyattii keessatti cimina argisiiseera.

title: The number 10 shirt must not retire with Messi
english: Following Lionel Messi's retirement from the Argentine national team, there is a debate about whether the number 10 jersey should be retired in his honor. The article argues that the shirt should remain available for future generations of players to wear. Messi’s legendary career and accomplishments have cemented his legacy, but the jersey should represent the future of Argentine football rather than being locked away in the past.
amharic: ሊዮኔል ሜሲ ከብሔራዊ ቡድን ጡረታ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ፣ የሜሲን ቁጥር 10 ማሊያ ከጨዋታ ውጭ ይደረግ ወይስ አይደረግ የሚለው ክርክር ተነስቷል። ጽሑፉ የቁጥር 10 ማሊያ ለወደፊት የአርጀንቲና ተጫዋቾች ተደራሽ ሆኖ ሊቀጥል እንደሚገባ ይከራከራል። የሜሲ አስደናቂ የስፖርት ህይወት ለታሪክ የሚቀመጥ ቢሆንም፣ ማሊያዋ ግን ለወደፊት ተተኪዎች ተስፋ መሆን አለባት እንጂ መታገድ የለባትም።
oromo: Liioneel Meesi garee biyyaalessaa Arjantiinaa irraa erga soorama bahee booda, uffata lakkoofsa 10 kan inni uffatu ture akka itti hin fayyadamne gochuu qabana moo miti kan jedhu falmii kaasera. Barruun kun, uffanni lakkoofsa 10 kun dhaloota dhufuuf akka turuufi dorgommii gara fuulduraa irratti akka itti fayyadaman yaada dhiyeessa. Guddina Meesiifi milkaa'inni isaa seenaa keessatti kan yaadatamu yoo ta'u, uffanni kun garuu bakka seenaa qofaatti osoo hin taane, gara fuulduraa kubbaa miillaa Arjantiinaa kan bakka bu'u ta'uu qaba.

title: Israeli drone strike kills two in southern Lebanon
english: An Israeli drone attack in southern Lebanon's Nabatieh district resulted in the deaths of two individuals. Beyond this strike, Israeli forces also conducted military operations and explosions in several other nearby villages and towns. These incidents highlight the ongoing regional tensions affecting multiple locations within southern Lebanon.
amharic: በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ናባቲዬ አውራጃ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ድሮን ጥቃት ሁለት ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተዘግቧል። ከዚህ ጥቃት በተጨማሪ የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በአካባቢው በሚገኙ ሌሎች መንደሮችና ከተሞች ላይም ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎችንና ፍንዳታዎችን አካሂደዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የክልሉ ውጥረት አመላካች ናቸው።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el naannoo Naabaatiyeetti miilaan haleellaa tirooniin raawwateen namoonni lama lubbuun darbaniiru. Haleellaa kana cinaatti, humni Israa'el baadiyaalee fi magaallan biroo naannichatti argamanirratti duula waraanaa fi dhukaasa gaggeessaniiru. Gochileen kun walitti bu'iinsi naannoo Kibba Libaanoositti dabalaa dhufe sun daangaa irra darbee bakkeewwan hedduu miidhaa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Revealed: Microsoft signed $125m contract with Israel during first year of Gaza war
english: Microsoft secured a contract valued at over $125 million with the Israeli government throughout 2024. This agreement was identified within the official Israeli finance ministry budget records released in early 2025. Although the deal was not widely publicized, it was discovered after a detailed examination of government expenditure documents.
amharic: ማይክሮሶፍት እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 ከእስራኤል መንግስት ጋር ከ125 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሚያወጣ ውል ተፈራርሟል። ይህ ስምምነት በ2025 መጀመሪያ ላይ በይፋ በወጣው የእስራኤል የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር የበጀት ሪፖርት ውስጥ ተገኝቷል። ስምምነቱ ለህዝብ በስፋት ባይገለጽም፣ የመንግስት የወጪ ሰነዶችን በጥልቀት በመመርመር ታውቋል።
oromo: Maaykiroosoftii bara 2024 keessa mootummaa Israa'el waliin waligaltee doolaara miiliyoona 125 oliin tilmaamamu mallatteesseera. Waligalteen kun baajata mootummaa Israa'el kan bara 2025 keessa ba'e keessatti kan argame yoo ta'u, ragaan kun ibsa baajata mootummaa irratti qorannoo godhamee booda kan adda baafameedha.

title: Palestinian rights group condemns Israeli minister’s Gaza forced displacement remarks
english: The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights has criticized Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz for proposing the forced relocation of Gazan residents by land, sea, and air. The organization argues that these plans, alongside Prime Minister Netanyahu’s territorial control claims, suggest an intentional strategy to change Gaza's population structure. They warned that such actions would be considered illegal under international law as a form of forced displacement.
amharic: የፍልስጤም የሰብአዊ መብቶች ማዕከል የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ ጋዛ ውስጥ የሚገኙ ነዋሪዎችን በጉልበት ለማፈናቀል ያቀረቡትን እቅድ አውግዟል። ድርጅቱ ይህ እቅድ እና ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የጋዛን መሬት መቆጣጠራቸው፣ የጋዛን የህዝብ ስብጥር ሆን ብሎ የመቀየር ሴራ እንደሆነ ገልጿል። እንደነዚህ ያሉ ድርጊቶች ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥሱ እና በጉልበት ለማፈናቀል የሚደረጉ ህገ-ወጥ ሙከራዎች እንደሆኑም አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Wiirtuun Mirga Namoomaa Palastiin, Ministirri Ittisa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz jiraattota Gaaza bakka buqqaasuuf karoora baasuun isaanii balaaleffateera. Dhaabbatichi karoora kanaa fi ibsi Mummichi Ministeeraa Beenjaamin Neetaanyaahuu Gaaza to'achuu isaanii irratti kennan, fedhii uummata Gaaza jijjiiruuf yaadame jedheera. Gochi kun seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsuu fi nama dirqamaan buqqaasuu kan dabalatu ta'uu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Jewish groups back stronger measures on Israel in letter to Andy Burnham
english: A group of prominent Jewish figures and Holocaust survivors has sent a letter to UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham, encouraging him to implement stricter policies against Israel. The signatories oppose the government's potential limitations on pro-Palestine demonstrations and argue that these marches are not inherently antisemitic. This move challenges other major Jewish organizations that have lobbied against the government's plans to sanction Israeli settlement goods.
amharic: የአይሁድ ማህበረሰብ መሪዎች እና የሆሎኮስት የተረፉ ቡድኖች ለብሪታኒያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አንዲ ቡርንሃም በጻፉት ደብዳቤ በእስራኤል ላይ ጠንከር ያለ እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ ቡድኖች በፓለስቲና ደጋፊ ሰልፎች ላይ የሚጣሉ እገዳዎችን በመቃወም ሰልፎቹ ፀረ-ሴማዊ አይደሉም የሚል አቋም ይዘዋል። ይህ አቋም በእስራኤል ላይ የሚወሰዱ የንግድ ማዕቀቦችን በመቃወም ከሌሎች ዋና ዋና የአይሁድ ተቋማት የተለየ ነው።
oromo: Gareen miseensota hawaasa Yihuudii fi warri Holokoostii irraa ooran tokko, Muummicha Ministeera Biritishii Andy Burnhamif xalayaa barreessuun tarkaanfii cimaa Israa'el irratti akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Gareen kun hiriirawwan deeggarsa Paalastinii irratti daangaa kaa'uun sirrii akka hin taane fi hiriirawwan kun jibba Yihuudii kan babal'isan miti jechuun falman. Tarkaanfiin kun dhaabbilee Yihuudii guguddaa biroo kanneen daldala Israa'el irratti adabbii kaa'uun faayidaa hin qabu jedhanii morman irraa adda ta'eera.

title: Revealed: Microsoft signed $125m contract with Israel during first year of Gaza war
english: Microsoft has entered into a new $125 million software licensing agreement with the Israeli Ministry of Defence during the first year of the Gaza war. While the specific nature of the software remains undisclosed, the contract is scheduled to run until 2027. Experts suggest this deal may be a continuation of a prior multi-year partnership between the tech giant and the Israeli military.
amharic: ማይክሮሶፍት በጋዛ ጦርነት የመጀመሪያ ዓመት ውስጥ ከእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ጋር የ125 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሶፍትዌር ፈቃድ ስምምነት ተፈራርሟል። ምንም እንኳን የሶፍትዌሩ ዝርዝር ሁኔታ ይፋ ባይደረግም ስምምነቱ እስከ 2027 ድረስ የሚቆይ ነው። የዘርፉ ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት ይህ ስምምነት በቴክኖሎጂ ኩባንያው እና በእስራኤል ጦር መካከል ቀደም ሲል የነበረው የረጅም ጊዜ ግንኙነት ቀጣይ ሊሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Maayikroosoft waraana Gaazaatti waggaa jalqabaa keessa ministeera ittisa biyyaa Israa'el waliin walii galtee sooftiweerii kaffaltii 125 miiliyoona dolaaraa mallatteesseera. Haala sooftiweerichaa irratti odeeffannoon bal'aan kennamuu baatus, walii galtichi hanga bara 2027 tti akka turu ibsameera. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, walii galtichi kun hariiroo kanaan dura dhaabbata teeknooloojii kanaafi raayyaa ittisa biyyaa Israa'el gidduutti ture kan itti fufe ta'uu mala.

title: UK support for Falkland Islands 'unwavering' after Argentina restates claims, No 10 says
english: The UK government has reaffirmed its commitment to the Falkland Islands following renewed sovereignty claims by Argentina’s President Javier Milei. President Milei stated he intends to impose sanctions on companies involved in local oil exploration, claiming the islands belong to Argentina. However, Downing Street emphasized that the UK will continue to protect the territory as long as its residents desire to remain a British overseas territory.
amharic: የአርጀንቲናው ፕሬዝዳንት ሀቪየር ሚሌይ በፎልክላንድ ደሴቶች ላይ የይገባኛል ጥያቄያቸውን ካነሱ በኋላ የብሪታንያ መንግስት ደሴቶቹን ለመጠበቅ ያላቸው አቋም ጸንቶ እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቋል። ፕሬዝዳንቱ በደሴቶቹ አካባቢ የነዳጅ ማውጣት ስራ ላይ የተሰማሩ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ማዕቀብ እንደሚጥሉ ገልጸዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የብሪታንያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጽህፈት ቤት የደሴቲቱ ነዋሪዎች የብሪታንያ ግዛት ሆነው ለመቀጠል እስፈለጉ ድረስ የብሪታንያ ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ እንደማይለያቸው አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Arjentiinaa Javier Milei naannoo Falklaandi irratti mirga abbummaa isaanii erga haaromsanii booda, mootummaan UK deeggarsa inni naannichaf qabu cimaa akka ta'e ibseera. Pirezidaantichi qorannoo boba'aa naannichatti geggeeffamu irratti hirmaatan irratti tarkaanfii akka fudhatu dhaadateera. Ta'us, mootummaan UK jiraattonni Falklaandi biyya Ingiliiziin buluuf fedhii qaban hamma qabantetti, naannicha ittisuuf qophiidha jedheera.

title: Trump's peace envoys to visit Moscow and Kyiv over weekend, reports say
english: President Trump's peace representatives, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, are traveling to Moscow and Kyiv this weekend to discuss potential ways to end the ongoing war. They are scheduled to meet with President Vladimir Putin on Saturday and President Volodymyr Zelensky on Sunday. While these diplomatic efforts suggest progress, significant disagreements regarding territorial demands still stand in the way of a peace agreement.
amharic: የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ የሰላም ልዑካን የሆኑት ጃሬድ ኩሽነር እና ስቲቭ ዊትኮፍ፣ በዩክሬን እና በሩሲያ መካከል ያለውን ጦርነት ለመፍታት በሚደረገው ጥረት፣ ቅዳሜ በሞስኮ እና እሁድ በኪቭ ጉብኝት ያደርጋሉ። ልዑካኑ ከፕሬዚዳንት ቭላድሚር ፑቲን እና ከፕሬዚዳንት ቮሎዲሚር ዘለንስኪ ጋር በመገናኘት ውይይት እንደሚያደርጉ ይጠበቃል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ተስፋ ሰጪ ቢሆኑም፣ በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው የክልል ይገባኛል ጥያቄ ለስምምነት ትልቅ እንቅፋት ሆኖ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ergamtoonni nageenyaa kan pirezidaant Traamp, Jaared Kushner fi Stiiv Witkof, waraana biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru dhaabsisuuf xiyyeeffannoon kan hojjetan yoo ta'u, torban kana gara Moskoo fi Kiyeef imaluuf jiru. Gareen kun Dilbata dura Moskootti Pirezidaant Vlaadimir Puutin wajjin, Dilbata immoo Kiyeefitti Pirezidaant Volodimiir Zelenski wajjin mari’atu jedhamee eegama. Sochiiwwan diippiloomaasii kun abdii kan kennan ta’us, gaaffiiwwan lafaa irratti walii galuun dhabamuun isaa furmaata nageenyaa irratti gufuu guddaa ta’ee itti fufeera.

title: Can the Green Party’s Polanski take on Labour and win Starmer’s old seat?
english: Green Party leader Zack Polanski is seeking to run for the Holborn and St Pancras parliamentary seat following the resignation of former Prime Minister Keir Starmer. While the Greens have gained significant local support in recent elections, political analysts view this as a difficult challenge because the constituency has been a reliable Labour stronghold for decades. Polanski’s success likely depends on national political shifts and whether Labour’s current popularity faces a decline before the upcoming by-election.
amharic: የአረንጓዴ ፓርቲ መሪ ዛክ ፖላንስኪ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኬር ስታርመር መልቀቃቸውን ተከትሎ በሆልቦርን እና ሴንት ፓንክራስ ለፓርላማ መቀመጫ ለመወዳደር እቅድ ይዘዋል። አረንጓዴ ፓርቲ በቅርብ ጊዜ በተካሄዱ ምርጫዎች በአካባቢው ተወዳጅነት ቢያገኝም፣ ይህ ወረዳ ለብዙ አሥርተ ዓመታት የሌበር ፓርቲ ምሽግ በመሆኑ ድሉን ከባድ እንደሚያደርገው የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች ይገልጻሉ። የፖላንስኪ ዕድል የሚወሰነው በአገሪቱ አጠቃላይ የፖለቲካ ለውጥ እና የሌበር ፓርቲ ተወዳጅነት በምርጫው ወቅት በሚኖረው ሁኔታ ላይ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan Paartii magariisaa Zaak Polaanskii, pirezidaantii duraanii Keer Staarmer iddoo isaanii gad-lakkisuu isaanii hordofee bakka bu'ummaa paarlaamaa Holboorn fi Sent Paankiras dorgomuuf murteeffataniiru. Paartiin magariisaa filannoo darbe keessa deggersa gahaa argatus, bakkeewwan kun waggoota dheeraaf kan paartii Leebarii waan ta'aniif mo'achuun rakkisaa akka ta'e ogeeyyiin siyaasaa dubbatu. Injifannoon Polaanskii kan hundaa'u jijjiirama siyaasa biyyattii fi filannoo guutuu dhufu dura beekamtiim ykn deggersii paartii Leebarii hir'achuu isaa irrattis ta'a.

title: Two Muslim women journalists allege police assault in India
english: Two female Muslim journalists have accused police officers in Delhi, India, of detaining and physically attacking them. In response, law enforcement officials have rejected these claims, stating that the women were only taken to the station due to a disagreement regarding vehicle parking. The situation remains a subject of dispute between the journalists and the local authorities.
amharic: ሁለት ሙስሊም ሴት ጋዜጠኞች በህንድ ዴሊ ከተማ በፖሊስ እንደተያዙና ድብደባ እንደተፈጸመባቸው ክስ አቅርበዋል። የፖሊስ ባለስልጣናት በበኩላቸው በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ መኪና በማቆም የተፈጠረ አለመግባባት እንጂ የተፈጸመ ጥቃት የለም በማለት ክሱን አስተባብለዋል። በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው የሃሳብ ልዩነት አሁንም በምርመራ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gaazexeessitoonni dubartoota Muslimaa lama ta'an tokko, magaalaa Deelii Hindii keessatti poolisiin qabamanii akka reebaman himatan. Qondaalonni poolisii gama isaaniitiin himannaa kana haaluun, dubartoonni kunneen kan qabaman walitti bu'iinsa bakka konkolaataa dhaabuu irratti uumameef qofa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Dhimmi kun ammaaf gamoo lamaan gidduutti falmii keessa jira.

title: Philippine court orders arrest of VP Duterte over President Marcos threats
english: A Philippine court has issued an arrest warrant for Vice President Sara Duterte following accusations that she threatened to have President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family members assassinated. While the Vice President faces these criminal grave threat charges, she is also simultaneously undergoing an impeachment trial that could remove her from office. Legal representatives for Duterte stated she intends to follow the law, and she is expected to post bail to remain free while the proceedings continue.

title: Ireland’s Katie Taylor eyes fairytale finish to trailblazing boxing career
english: Irish boxing legend Katie Taylor is preparing for the final fight of her historic career at Dublin's Croke Park this Saturday. The 40-year-old athlete will face undefeated challenger Flora Pili in a bid to secure a third undisputed world championship title in front of 80,000 home fans. Taylor, a pioneer who helped gain Olympic inclusion for women's boxing, intends to focus entirely on her performance despite the emotional significance of her retirement.

title: Conflicts and extreme weather pushing global food prices higher, warns UN
english: The United Nations reports that global food prices have reached a four-year peak due to the combined impact of armed conflicts and severe weather patterns. Major supply routes and fertilizer shipments are being disrupted by geopolitical tensions, while heatwaves and climate phenomena are negatively affecting crop production. Experts warn that these increased wholesale costs will likely lead to higher grocery prices for consumers and could significantly worsen global hunger.

title: 'Layer upon layer of miracles': How Nepal flood survivors were rescued from tunnel
english: A rescue team led by international experts and the Nepalese army successfully saved two men trapped inside a tunnel after catastrophic flash floods buried the entrance. Rescuers had to use old maps and satellite imagery to locate the buried opening and carefully employed explosives to clear massive debris without harming the survivors. The operation also required draining significant amounts of floodwater, which rescue leaders described as a miraculous effort given the extreme challenges.

title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage and Russia is the chief suspect
english: European nations are facing a growing wave of sabotage and arson attacks against defense facilities, which officials largely attribute to Russian involvement. Recent incidents include explosive drones discovered at a German airport and mysterious fires at military supply factories across several countries like Italy and Estonia. While Russia denies these accusations, European leaders are warning of an intensified strategy of hybrid warfare and urging increased vigilance.

title: US diesel prices hit an all-time-high
english: Diesel prices in the United States have reached record highs due to global supply disruptions caused by the ongoing war between the US-Israel and Iran. To address the resulting economic strain and public dissatisfaction, President Trump has established a new oil deal with Venezuela to increase domestic fuel supplies. Despite this initiative, some experts remain doubtful that the partnership will quickly resolve the rising costs impacting the transportation and agricultural sectors.

title: Reform UK officials step down as new funding scandal hits far-right party
english: Two high-ranking officials from Britain's Reform UK party have resigned following a documentary that accused them of violating election funding laws. The investigation alleged that the party sought to bypass rules by allowing an overseas company to pay for polling services. While party leader Nigel Farage denies any wrongdoing, both the police and rival political parties are now looking into the claims.

title: Argentina’s Milei threatens sanctions as he refocuses on Falklands
english: Argentine President Javier Milei has announced plans to implement strict sanctions against international companies involved in oil exploration near the Falkland Islands, which Argentina claims as its territory. By targeting firms like Rockhopper Exploration and their partners, Milei aims to assert Argentine sovereignty and strengthen his domestic political standing. While the UK government rejected these threats and reaffirmed its control over the islands, the move reflects a strategic effort by the Argentine leader to shift public focus toward national interests.
amharic: የአርጀንቲናው ፕሬዚዳንት ሃቪየር ሚሌይ በአርጀንቲና የይገባኛል ጥያቄ የሚቀርብባቸውን የፎክላንድ ደሴቶች አካባቢ በነዳጅ ፍለጋ ላይ ለተሰማሩ ዓለም አቀፍ ኩባንያዎች ላይ ጠንካራ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ማቀዳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የሀገሪቱን ሉዓላዊነት ለማስከበር እና የፕሬዚዳንቱ የፖለቲካ ተቀባይነትን ለማሳደግ ያለመ ነው። የብሪታንያ መንግስት የደሴቶቹን ቁጥጥር እንደሚያረጋግጥ በመግለጽ ይህንን ዛቻ ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የሁለቱ ሀገራት የዲፕሎማሲ ውጥረትም አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Arjentiinaa Javier Milei naannoo qiyyeeffannoo Arjentiinaa ta'e kan jiraattota Falkland jedhamanii waamamanii fi isheen Las Malvinas jettuutti, hojii qorannoo boba'aa kan gaggeessan dhaabbilee idil-addunyaa irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf karoorsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kun ivala biyyattii mirkaneessuufi fayyadamummaa siyaasaa ofii of harkatti galchuuf kan karoorfame dha. Mootummaan Biritaaniyaa harka isaa qabu mirkaneessuun soda kana kan morme yoo ta'u, walitti bu'iinsi dippilomaasii kun itti fufuun isaa ni yaadatama.

title: ‘Build The Wall’: White House arcade games face backlash
english: The White House is facing criticism for releasing a series of arcade games designed to promote Donald Trump’s political agenda. Critics are arguing that using public funds for these games is inappropriate. Furthermore, many have condemned the games for depicting migrants and people facing deportation in an offensive and dehumanizing manner.
amharic: የኋይት ሀውስ የዶናልድ ትራምፕን የፖለቲካ አጀንዳ ለማስተዋወቅ ታስበው የተሰሩ የቪዲዮ ጨዋታዎችን ይፋ ማድረጉ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። ተቺዎች የመንግስትን ገንዘብ ለእንደዚህ አይነት ጨዋታዎች ማዋሉ ተገቢ አይደለም ሲሉ ይተቻሉ። በተጨማሪም ጨዋታዎቹ ስደተኞችን እና በስደት ላይ ያሉ ሰዎችን የሚያንቋሽሽ እና ሰብአዊ ክብርን የሚነካ ይዘት አላቸው በሚል ከፍተኛ ወቀሳ እየቀረበባቸው ነው።
oromo: Mana Maree Adii (White House) sagantaa siyaasaa Donald Trump beeksisuuf taphoota interneetii ykn 'arcade' gadi lakkisuun isaa mormii guddaa kaaseera. Namoonni hedduun maallaqni ummataa taphoota akkanaaf ooluu hin qabu jechuun komachaa jiru. Kana malees, taphoonni kun godaantotaa fi namoota biyyaa baafamaa jiran ibsuuf kan fayyadaman haala xiqqeessaa fi kabaja namummaa xureessuun akka ta'e dubbatamaa jira.

title: Meloni sets a record, leading Italy’s longest-serving government since WWII
english: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has achieved a historic milestone by leading the longest-lasting consecutive government in Italy since the end of World War II. Her administration surpassed the previous record of 1,412 days, marking a significant departure from the country's usual history of political turnover. While supporters celebrate this durability as a major achievement, some political analysts caution that such longevity does not necessarily guarantee long-term stability.
amharic: የኢጣሊያ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ጆርጂያ ሜሎኒ ከሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት ወዲህ በጣሊያን ታሪክ ረጅሙን ጊዜ በስልጣን ላይ የቆየ መንግስት በመምራት ታሪካዊ ክብረ ወሰን አስመዝግበዋል። አስተዳደራቸው ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን የ1,412 ቀናት የረጅም ጊዜ የስልጣን ክብረ ወሰን በመስበር፣ ሀገሪቱ በፖለቲካዊ አለመረጋጋት ከነበረችበት የተለመደ ታሪክ የተለየ ምዕራፍ ከፍተዋል። ደጋፊዎች ይህንን የስልጣን ቆይታ እንደ ትልቅ ስኬት ቢመለከቱትም፣ አንዳንድ የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች ግን ረጅም ጊዜ በስልጣን ላይ መቆየት ብቻውን የተረጋጋ አስተዳደር መኖሩን እንደማያረጋግጥ ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Mummichi Ministiraa Xaaliyaanii Giorgia Meloni, erga waraanni addunyaa lammaffaan xumuramee as mootummaa biyyattii keessatti walitti aansuudhaan yeroo dheeraaf aangoo irra ture hogganuun seenaa hojjetaniiru. Mootummaan isaanii guyyoota 1,412 tureen rikoordii kanaan dura ture cabsuudhaan, Xaaliyaaniin qulqullummaa siyaasaatiin kan beekamtu ta'us jijjiirama guddaa agarsiisaniiru. Deeggartoonni isaanii milkaa'ina kana yoo kabajatan, ogeeyyonni siyaasaa tokko tokko garuu aangoo irra turuun qofaan tasgabbii siyaasaa fi bulchiinsa gaarii mirkaneessuuf gahaa miti jechuudhaan akeekkachiisu.

title: Israel takes its war on Palestine into the AI age
english: Israel is reportedly utilizing a sophisticated propaganda campaign that employs artificial intelligence to influence public perception of the conflict in Gaza. An investigation revealed that a fake think tank, funded by the Israeli government, generated vast amounts of content specifically designed to be ingested by search engines and AI chatbots. By creating automated, targeted reports, this operation aims to shape the information that AI systems provide to users worldwide.
amharic: እስራኤል በጋዛ ግጭት ላይ የህዝብ ግንዛቤን ለመቅረጽ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን በመጠቀም የተራቀቀ የፕሮፓጋንዳ ዘመቻ እያካሄደች መሆኑ ተገልጧል። ምርመራዎች እንደሚያሳዩት በእስራኤል መንግስት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ የሚደረግለት የውሸት የምርምር ተቋም፣ በፍለጋ ሞተሮች እና በኤአይ ቻትቦቶች በቀላሉ እንዲዋጡ ታስበው የተዘጋጁ በርካታ ይዘቶችን አምርቷል። ይህ ድርጊት አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ለተጠቃሚዎች የሚሰጠውን መረጃ ለመቆጣጠር እና ተጽዕኖ ለማሳደር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el walitti bu'iinsa Gaazaa irratti ilaalcha uummataa jijjiiruuf teknooloojii aritifaal ispeeshil (AI) fayyadamuun duula oduu sobaa babal'isuu akka jirtu qorannoon tokko ifoomseera. Mootummaa Israa'eliin kan deeggaramu dhaabbanni qorannoo sobaa tokko, odeeffannoo sirnoota barbaacha intarneetii fi AI bira salphaatti gahuuf gargaaru hedduu akka uume ibsameera. Hojiin kun sirnoonni AI kun namootaaf odeeffannoo yeroo kennan akka fedha isaaniitti akka ta'uuf yaalii gochaa jiru dha.
